rows.Description:
Forming a trinity with Spirit Manipulation and the Path of the Velvet Shadow, Aether Crafting allows an Ashipu to manipulate the very spiritual essence of creatures inhabiting the divine world. As with all paths related to the Umbra and Spirits, it is extremely dangerous for Kindred. Every spirit has its own personality and agenda that a Kindred must attend to.

Cross-reference: See also 'The Path of Aether Crafting' (also in OWBN Custom Paths), which is the same content submitted with the full title prefix. Both entries are preserved for completeness.
rows.Levels: [{"Level": 1, "Name": "Name the Nameless", "Description": "Spend one blood and make a Mental Challenge against a spirit (retest Occult). If successful, learn the name by which the spirit goes \u2014 not its True Name, but the name it uses. This allows the Ashipu to research more information on that Spirit."}, {"Level": 2, "Name": "Divinity of Vitae", "Description": "Spend one blood to activate for the next scene or hour. During this time, spend 1 blood trait to transform it into an Essence trait that can be given to a spirit, allowing for covenants with spirits who would otherwise have no interest in dealing with a Kindred."}, {"Level": 3, "Name": "Craft Simulacrum", "Description": "Spend one blood and one willpower to place a spirit into a prepared stone vessel (statues symbolic of the spirit). The Simulacrum has the same personality as the possessing spirit but is bound to the caster's service. Duration determined by willpower spent (1=One Day, 2=Three Days, 3=One Week, 4=One Month, 5=6 Months). Stats: Physical Brawny 4/Dexterous 3/Resilient 5, Mental Clever 4/Disciplined 4/Observant 4, Social Charismatic 3/Beguiling 4/Intimidating 5, plus Armor, Blast, Tracking, Incite Frenzy."}, {"Level": 4, "Name": "Divine Awakening", "Description": "Spend a Willpower and engage the target in a Mental Challenge (retest Awareness). If successful, the target's consciousness is forced into the Astral Realm as per Astral Projection. Lasts a scene or an hour. If the target possesses Astral Projection, they may return to their body after three seconds (or next round in combat). If the target does not possess Astral Projection, spend an additional Willpower."}, {"Level": 5, "Name": "Divine Weapons", "Description": "Spend 1 blood and 1 willpower to manifest a psychic mystical weapon. These weapons do not deal physical damage \u2014 instead, damage removes temporary willpower traits. Armor, damage reduction, and Fortitude offer no protection. The weapons may also be used while Astral Projecting. Only the caster may use them; they last a scene or hour and cannot be enhanced or augmented."}]

rows.Description: Based on the path of Spirit Manipulation, this path was created by Rosamonde Kurlein, with input and assistance of Liam McGovern and other Tremere in Northern California, to allow the thaumaturge to interact with the astral realm. Unlike Spirit Manipulation, there is no inherent risk of being attacked by spirits if the practitioner loses a challenge. Instead the inherent risk comes from primarily interacting with other astral travelers, who may not be friendly. Note that all powers which are indicated as targeting or affecting astral travelers may also be used to target or affect other astral entities, if encountered.
rows.Levels: [{"Level": 1, "Name": "Astral Sight", "Description": "With this power you can perceive the astral realm, allowing you to gaze deeply into it, or perceive nearby astral travelers as a hazy overlay on the material world. This power does not allow you to see into the lands of the dead, the realms of the fae, or the spirit world. You may activate this power at will and automatically see any astral travelers or entities close by. If you wish to gaze into the astral realm itself, you must spend a Mental Trait; you may then see into the astral realm for the duration of the scene. While looking into the astral realm, you must bid an additional two Traits on any challenges in the physical world due to divided perceptions. You may terminate this power at any time."}, {"Level": 2, "Name": "Astral Voice", "Description": "Not all astral travelers speak English, or can communicate with individuals in the physical world. With this power you can understand and communicate with astral travelers. Spending a Willpower Trait activates this power for the remainder of the scene. As long as the power is active, you may converse with astral travelers, regardless of language utilized, and understand their responses."}, {"Level": 3, "Name": "Astral Manifestation", "Description": "This power allows you to give orders to an astral traveler, or cause the astral traveler to become visible and audible in the physical world. To use this power, spend a Willpower Trait and make a Mental Challenge against the astral traveler. With success, you may either cause the astral traveler to become visible (as per a manifested Astral Projection, with no cost to the astral traveler) and audible (as though subject to Whispers of the Ghost) in the physical world for the remainder of the scene, or force the astral traveler to obey whatever command you give, as long as it doesn't endanger the astral traveler's well-being or conflict with her morals. Note that unless other powers are used, the astral traveler may be fully aware she is being forced into something against her will, and may seek revenge later."}, {"Level": 4, "Name": "Entrap Astral Ephemera", "Description": "With this power, you may trap an astral traveler in the astral realm, or even anchor it to a specific object. To use this power, spend a Willpower Trait and make a Mental Challenge against the astral traveler. With success, the astral traveler's silver cord snaps regardless of his current remaining Willpower Traits, stranding him in the astral realm. To anchor a stranded astral traveler to a particular object or location, engage the stranded astral traveler in a Mental Challenge. If you win, the stranded astral traveler cannot leave the room (or move more than 10 feet from a particular object) for the remainder of the evening. The stranded astral traveler may expend Willpower Traits to resist, forcing you to expend a Mental Trait for each Willpower spent. Spending a temporary Willpower at the time of this Mental Challenge forces the stranded astral traveler to remain for a full week; a permanent Willpower Trait extends this to a year. An astral traveler anchored to his original physical body will cause the silver cord to regenerate within seconds, returning him to his body."}, {"Level": 5, "Name": "Astral Duality", "Description": "The height of astral transactions \u2014 you can now fully interact with the astral realm. When you activate this power, you exist in both planes simultaneously. You can pick up objects or beings in the material world and place them in the astral realm or vice versa. You can even use Thaumaturgy or other Disciplines in either world. To activate, spend a Willpower Trait and make a Static Mental Challenge. If successful, make a Simple Test. If you lose, repeat the test twice \u2014 a third consecutive loss means you were ripped out of the physical world and thrown into the astral realm. If entrance was successful, make Simple Tests until you lose \u2014 the number of tests won determines the duration (0 wins = One turn, 1 win = Three turns, 2 wins = Ten turns, 3 wins = Ten minutes, 4 wins = Remainder of the scene). While active, you must bid two additional Traits on all challenges due to perceiving two realms simultaneously."}]

rows.Blood Magic Category: Voudoun Wanga - Serpents of the Light
rows.Description: A cornerstone of many Afro-Caribbean religions is a focus on community. To endorse agreements, contracts often take on an air of ritual under the auspices of Ayelala, the Orisha of oaths and divination. Some Wangateurs began invoking her name during negotiations, and over centuries the practice developed into Ayelala's Accord. Ayelala's Accord is a subtle art — most who are subjected to its authority are never aware of the Orisha's touch. Its use does not manifest in overt hand gestures or mystical phrases, and even supernatural attempts to detect its use must be made as contested challenges against the Wangateur. Challenges relating to Ayelala's Accord retest using the Occult ability.
rows.Levels: [{"Level": 1, "Name": "Ayelala's Authority", "Description": "Whether or not an oath is sealed in Ayelala's name, the Orisha's province of justice and judgment gives her the ability to see those connections as plain as day. Invoking this authority can verify whether or not such an oath exists. System: Spend a Blood Trait and make a Static Mental Challenge. If successful, the caster learns the nature of any oaths, pacts, bonds, or spiritual ties (Blood Bonds, covenants, Infernal Bargains, etc.), current or broken, between the target and any other beings. Note that this does not inherently reveal to whom such connections are to."}, {"Level": 2, "Name": "Straying from Trust", "Description": "Agreements are the foundation of community. While it is possible to conceal the breaking of an ordinary covenant, the violation of an oath confirmed with Ayelala's Accord never remains hidden for long. System: Whenever an explicit agreement is made (either a promise, an oath, a deal, etc.), either verbal or written, you may spend 1 Willpower Trait to formalize it. The Wangateur is automatically made aware when a formalized agreement has been broken or violated, and they may make a Static Mental Challenge (difficulty determined by the Storyteller) to ascertain the details of the violation."}, {"Level": 3, "Name": "Peer Through Truth", "Description": "For those who invoke Ayelala's domain to pursue her justice in the world, the oaths others make are like open books. A Wangateur skilled enough in Ayelala's Accord can determine the specific terms of an agreement an individual has made, simply by studying their soul. System: The caster spends 1 Blood Trait and makes a Static Mental Challenge against their victim. If successful, they learn the details of one of the target's oaths (pacts, bonds, or spiritual ties). The caster must be aware of the oath's existence beforehand, either through Ayelala's Authority or some other means. Random guesses or rumors are not sufficient justification."}, {"Level": 4, "Name": "Many Eyes of Ayelala", "Description": "It is not unheard of for those who form unfavorable compacts to attempt an escape from their responsibilities. Fortunately, Ayelala's mastery of divination enables her to locate those who have confirmed oaths in her name. System: Many Eyes of Ayelala may only be performed upon a target who has engaged in an oath sealed with Straying from Trust. The caster spends 1 Blood Trait and makes a Static Mental Challenge. If successful, the caster gains intuitive knowledge of the oath swearer's exact location, and may engage in a second Mental Challenge against the target to remotely observe the individual and their surroundings for the duration of a scene. This power works even if the target is in another plane of existence."}, {"Level": 5, "Name": "Fulfilling the Vow", "Description": "Ayelala is unrelenting in her demand for justice when it comes to the fulfillment of an oath. She has even been known to visit death upon those who make promises they are incapable of keeping. System: The Wangateur spends 1 Willpower Trait and makes a Mental Challenge against their target. Success compels the target to complete the terms agreed upon under Straying from Trust with all due haste and to the best of their ability. The target will take all possible precautions to avoid situations that might prevent them from the completion of their agreement. In the event that a Kindred target has agreed to terms which they are incapable of fulfilling, they instead succumb to torpor lasting the normal duration set by their Humanity or Path of Enlightenment rating. Should the victim be a non-Kindred, they instead suffer 5 unsoakable levels of aggravated damage which cannot be absorbed, negated, redirected, or otherwise affected, and which can only be healed at a rate of one health level per month regardless of any supernatural healing the victim may possess or seek out."}]

rows.Description: A path combining biological constructs with computer components, allowing a thaumaturge to hack, manipulate, and interface with electronic systems in novel ways.
rows.Levels: [{"Level": 1, "Name": "Code Hack", "Description": "With the cost of 1 temporary willpower trait per use and 10 minutes examining source code, the caster can fix all bugs or completely change the source code as desired. Grants +1 mental trait per willpower spent, lasting the scene or one hour."}, {"Level": 2, "Name": "Photo Shop", "Description": "Cost 1 temporary mental trait and 1 blood with 10 minutes examining the device or picture. Modify a picture as desired. When directed toward a biological subject, make physical changes akin to the Disguise ability that appear real to the naked or trained eye. Only magic can discern the disguise."}, {"Level": 3, "Name": "Trace and Logs", "Description": "Smear a point of blood on a computerized device and spend a temporary mental trait for each day of tracking. The blood can trace compiled data or function as a script, logging all information on the device for up to 3 days."}, {"Level": 4, "Name": "Minor Bio-AI", "Description": "Construct a Minor Biological AI (takes 1 month to build). Spend temporary mental traits at construction; the AI lasts 1 week per trait spent. Intelligence equals user's Mental traits + Computer skill (max 5). Can perform the first three levels of bio-hacking on its own without blood; all other costs still apply."}, {"Level": 5, "Name": "Major Bio-AI", "Description": "Construct a Major Biological AI (6 weeks to build). Functions for 1 month per temporary mental trait spent at construction, or permanently for 1 permanent mental trait. Gains health/firewall levels equal to the caster's Security ability (minimum 1). Immune to Technomancy due to its biological components."}]

rows.Description: This Path was created in the Night Falls (NVA) chronicle by Vincent King. It was submitted by Berkeley, CA because the Arcane Compendium from 2010 in which it was originally contained is no longer valid, and it has not yet been submitted to the OWBN custom content database. It allows the thaumaturge to manipulate ice and cold.
rows.Levels: [{"Level": 1, "Name": "Ran's Touch", "Description": "By concentrating, the thaumaturge can freeze a small area, rendering simple devices useless. To activate this power the target must be touched and a single blood trait must be spent, then the caster engages in a Mental vs. Physical challenge. An additional Blood Trait must be spent for a currently moving target. This cannot be employed on a living or undead target."}, {"Level": 2, "Name": "Grasp of Magni", "Description": "A slightly larger area of space can now be frozen and the thaumaturge no longer needs to touch the target. By spending a Mental Trait the caster may create a small (up to a cubic foot) block of ice. If targeting a person or something a person is grasping, the caster must engage in a Mental vs. Physical Challenge. The Ice can halt movement of a person or machine, and will last until melted or broken (static Physical vs. 6 traits)."}, {"Level": 3, "Name": "Forseti's Silence", "Description": "With this level of control the thaumaturge can create a wall of Ice. The wall is three cubic feet of ice for each Mental Trait spent to cast it, has as many Enduring Physical Traits as Mental Traits spent to cast it, and has health levels equal to half of the Mental Traits spent (rounded down). The wall must be summoned in unoccupied space within 50 feet of the caster."}, {"Level": 4, "Name": "Hel's Kiss", "Description": "The thaumaturge can literally freeze the blood of a chosen target. By spending a Willpower and winning a Mental vs. Physical challenge against the target, up to 3 Traits of Blood are frozen in the target's veins. A Mental Trait must be spent for each Blood Trait frozen. For mortals this causes a lethal wound for each blood frozen, and renders that blood permanently useless fluid. For Kindred this makes the blood unusable for 5 Minutes or the end of a scene. In both cases the target is down one Physical trait for each blood trait frozen."}, {"Level": 5, "Name": "Tomb of Buri", "Description": "This power can completely encase a single target in a Tomb of Ice. The thaumaturgist must concentrate for a full turn, expend a Willpower Trait and initiate a Mental vs. Physical Challenge against the target. The Tomb has as many Enduring Physical Traits as Mental Traits spent to cast it, and has health levels equal to half of the Mental Traits spent (rounded down). If a Mortal is trapped in the Block of Ice they take one Lethal wound each round until broken free. The victim may attempt to break out by initiating a physical challenge from within."}]

rows.Description: The cosmos exists as an ever-flowing tapestry of patterns. The Breath of Pangu, often referred to as Prime by True Mages, is the quintessential flow of that energy. This path is used by the TMR to participate in mystical studies conducted alongside Mage Allies.
rows.Levels: [{"Level": 1, "Name": "See the Flow", "Description": "Costs 1 Blood and 1 Willpower to activate. While active, you may notice and read active magical effects on a person, object, or place. With a static mental challenge (retest Occult, difficulty 6 for vampires, +3 for stranger entities), identify the effects and origins of active magic, including what sort of power is used (faith, glamour, gnosis, etc.)."}, {"Level": 2, "Name": "Blood of Heaven", "Description": "Costs 1 Blood and 1 Willpower to activate (not usable in combat). Imbue a trait of blood, turning it into Tass usable by a True Mage. A Mage may not benefit from this more times in a single day than their Avatar rating. Drinking too much of this Tass can cause an unwitting Mage to gain Jhor, at Storyteller discretion."}, {"Level": 3, "Name": "Purifying Wave", "Description": "Spend 1 Blood and 1 Willpower plus 1 temporary Willpower per level of Taint cleansed. Cleanse an area of spiritual corruption (Wyrm Taint, Demon Chi, or similar corrupting forces). Some places may require multiple uses; each practitioner may only use this once per night in a given location."}, {"Level": 4, "Name": "Warding Sign", "Description": "While wearing a visible symbol painted with owl's blood, you may make the usual contested Willpower Challenge to counter True Magick but are considered up two traits on this challenge. Any True Magick effects that successfully target the character suffer a -3 penalty to the total Grades of success."}, {"Level": 5, "Name": "Shape the Flow of Essence", "Description": "Spend 1 Blood and 1 Willpower. Shift the balance of an area within permanent Willpower x5 yards. Effects include: shifting Resonance, raising/reducing the Gauntlet or Shroud by two (making things in those realms visible if reduced below 5), revealing Astral Plane figures, or causing all Sphere Magick to gain +1 Grade of Success."}]

rows.Blood Magic Category: Voudoun Wanga - Serpents of the Light
rows.Description: Once a proud Yoruban king, Chango enjoys immense popularity among the devout of the Santeria faith. He and his wife, Oya, wield the power of lightning as their favored weapon. By forging an association with these two Orishas, a Cainite can borrow a small portion of Chango's and Oya's power for themselves, to devastating effect. Some would claim that the Wangateur is merely imitating a powerful deity, but the faithful know the truth — that their lightning is a blessing bestowed upon them by a proud king and his fierce queen.
rows.Levels: [{"Level": 1, "Name": "Chango's Spiteful Vigor", "Description": "Virility is one of Chango's most well-known traits. Chango's Spiteful Vigor allows the caster to channel some of that excess energy into anyone they come into contact with, momentarily filling them with more vigor than their body can handle, causing it to spasm out of control. Spend 1 Blood Trait. Electricity crackles around the vampire's eyes and fingertips, enough to ignite readily flammable materials (such as gasoline or cloth, though not wood). Anyone who comes in contact with the caster suffers the negative physical trait Clumsy for the rest of the turn as the shock causes their body to briefly twitch uncontrollably. Once activated, this power lasts for an hour or the scene, or until the Cainite decides to cancel it."}, {"Level": 2, "Name": "Favored Arms", "Description": "Both Chango and his wife, Oya, wield the power over the domain of lightning, to devastating effect on the battlefield. The caster must spend 1 Blood Trait. The electricity coursing through the Vampire's body can arc across short distances to affect those nearby. Engage in a ranged Mental challenge with a target within 30 yards. The target uses their Physical traits to soak, and must bid an additional trait while attempting to do so, as lightning can strike rather quickly. If successful, the lightning strikes its intended victim, dealing 1 health level of lethal damage and igniting anything flammable it comes into contact with."}, {"Level": 3, "Name": "Hushed Whispers", "Description": "Oya is known as the 'Mother of Nine' because she gave birth to nine individual stillborn children. Hushed Whispers is a direct reflection of the sadness and emptiness she feels for being unable to bear children, and a manifestation of the eternal silence of those nine lost children. The caster spends 1 Blood Trait and must make a static mental challenge against an appropriate difficulty (4 for standard electronics, 6 for shielded power supplies, 10 for military grade hardware, or more at the narrator's discretion). The electromagnetic wave generated by the electricity in the Cainite's body pulses outward a short distance, causing any electronic devices within 10 feet to be disabled as their batteries are immediately drained, and the devices cannot receive power for the remainder of the scene."}, {"Level": 4, "Name": "King's Decree", "Description": "Before being elevated to an Orisha for performing miracles after his death, Chango was the third King of Oyo. He is of boisterous temperament, and is said to be the essence of masculinity. His indomitably assertive nature is something that can be channeled to staggering effect. The Cainite must spend 1 Blood Trait. By channeling the fury of Chango, the Cainite is able to release a devastating sonic burst. All within 10 yards of the caster are knocked to the ground and must spend an action to get to their feet again before taking any other physical actions. Affected individuals also suffer the Negative Mental Trait Oblivious for one minute as the intense sound ruptures ear drums. Any who have a means of heightening their hearing become stunned and can take no actions except to defend themselves for the remainder of the turn, and are deafened for the remainder of the scene or hour."}, {"Level": 5, "Name": "Stride of Yansa", "Description": "Oya is a fierce warrior Orisha who wields the might of storms as her weapon. Through this penultimate mastery of divine favor, the Cainite transcends the physical form, becoming for the briefest of moments the pure essence of Oya's stride. The Wangateur spends 1 Blood Trait and 1 Willpower Trait. For a brief instant the Cainite's body transcends the physical, becoming lightning itself. In this lightning form, the Cainite can move with impossible speeds and can cover great distances in a few seconds. While in this form, the caster suffers no damage except from sunlight and magic, but is incapable of interacting with surroundings in any meaningful way. This form begins on the caster's turn and only lasts until the end of the round. Storytellers are advised to limit the distance to about 100 miles per round and not allow such travel to interrupt the flow of game play."}]

rows.Description: This path can only be used on other willing individuals. Any attempt to use this on oneself will fail. Physical contact with the target is required for all levels. No level can be used on more targets per night than the user's permanent Occult rating.
rows.Levels: [{"Level": 1, "Name": "To Have Earth, To Feel Water", "Description": "Spend a blood and a mental trait. The target may ignore the effects of any negative trait for the night. This also provides justification for the user to buy off the negative trait using XP. Can only be applied once per target, per night."}, {"Level": 2, "Name": "To Act Fire, To Accept Air", "Description": "Spend a blood and a mental trait. The target may ignore the effects of any derangement for the scene. This does not completely remove the derangement for purposes of possessing Dementation; it only alleviates the symptoms and characteristics of it. This also provides justification for the user to buy off the derangement using XP. Can only be applied once per target, per night."}, {"Level": 3, "Name": "To Express Sound", "Description": "Spend a blood and a temporary willpower. The target may permanently reduce any one blood bond to zero, therefore removing it completely from their sheet. The removal of this bond should feel like a burden being lifted from their soul and should be roleplayed accordingly. As a side effect, after the casting, for the next month, the target's blood suffers a backlash and is unable to effectively forge a new bond or increase an existing one."}, {"Level": 4, "Name": "To See Light", "Description": "Spend a blood and a temporary willpower. You can temporarily remove any social penalty based on morality levels and any signs of an individual's vampiric nature. This includes but isn't limited to a pale complexion or aura, and flaws like Obvious Predator or Touch of Frost. The benefit of this power only lasts for a scene, it can only be used once on a subject per night, and can be used as a justification to buy off supernatural flaws with XP at the ST's discretion."}, {"Level": 5, "Name": "To Know Thought", "Description": "Spend a blood and a permanent willpower. The target becomes permanently free from all effects of the Dominate discipline they are currently under. This includes but is not limited to outstanding/untriggered Dominate commands, any effects of Conditioning or Forgetful Mind, and any other levels or Dominate-based combination disciplines that may be affecting or hindering the target. This does not protect the target from any future conditions. The caster may spend an additional willpower to affect Elder level Dominate, however will automatically fail against Master levels or higher."}]

rows.Description:
Based on the idea that Technomancy was insufficient for information control purposes. Unlike Technomancy, which focuses on technological devices, Data Manipulation is focused on the detection and manipulation of the data itself. Uses the Computers Ability for retests rather than Occult.

Cross-reference: This path also appears in the OWBN Archivist database under the name 'Path of Data Manipulation' (Archivist entry #25991). The content is identical; only the entry title differs.
rows.Levels: [{"Level": 1, "Name": "Data Perception", "Description": "Activate at will to automatically detect active electronic devices and perceive active transmission of electronic data. Spend a Mental Trait to also read or comprehend electronic data in transmission. Requires line of sight on some portion of the transmission's path. Cannot make securely encrypted data clear."}, {"Level": 2, "Name": "Communication", "Description": "Spending a Willpower Trait activates this for the remainder of the scene. You may comprehend and transmit electronic data, magically communicating with any electronic device you can perceive, regardless of whether it normally includes wireless communication. Does not bypass security features."}, {"Level": 3, "Name": "Control Data", "Description": "Spend a Willpower Trait and interface with an active device using Communication. Spend Mental Traits (determined by Storyteller) to bypass secure encryption, alter/rewrite data, or bypass passwords. To activate an inactive device, have line of sight and spend a Willpower Trait."}, {"Level": 4, "Name": "Shutdown", "Description": "Spend a Mental Trait and make a Static Mental Challenge against any single device (Traits by device complexity: cell phones 1, desktop computers 3, servers 9+, military hardware gains +3). Success allows disabling, data erasure, or destroying small electronics and storage media."}, {"Level": 5, "Name": "Pulse", "Description": "Spend a Willpower Trait and make a Static Mental Challenge to simultaneously affect all electronic devices within 10x your permanent Willpower in yards, rendering them non-functional for the scene. Spend additional Willpower for data erasure or destruction of small electronics. You may not exempt any devices, including your own."}]

rows.Description: This path was developed to help the Giovanni family gain access to the powers of Arcanoi without having to rely on wraiths, and to discourage stockpiling of fetishes. The Practitioner must be skilled in Soulforging. Prior to creating any object, the Practitioner must subdue the wraith they wish to soulforge. If the item is to be given to another, that individual MUST be present for the creation and must provide the blood required to enchant the item. Each of the final three powers require XP provided by the intended owner (1 point for Minor, 2 for Moderate, 3 for Major). This power will only work on Soulforged Items. The craft level of the item limits the amount of Pathos it can hold: Craft 1=2 Pathos (Innate/Basic), Craft 2=4 Pathos (Innate/Basic), Craft 3=4 Pathos (up to Intermediate), Craft 4=6 Pathos (up to Intermediate), Craft 5=8 Pathos (up to Advanced). Should the final magic test to activate the Arcanoi fail, the item may never have its powers awaken. Anyone learning this path loses the ability to activate spiritual fetishes entirely.
rows.Levels: [{"Level": 1, "Name": "Detect Potential", "Description": "You may expend a Mental Trait and engage a Wraith in a Social Challenge (retest Wraith Lore). Should you win, you may gain some information about what Arcanoi this wraith has access to. Win or lose, the wraith is aware that you are trying to find out its secrets. This power may only be used on wraiths that are in the same plane of existence as the Necromancer."}, {"Level": 2, "Name": "Soothing the Soul", "Description": "This power is used to 'charge' soulforged items with the Pathos they need to be activated. Expend a number of Mental Traits equal to the number of Pathos you will to recharge, then engage in a static Mental Challenge (difficulty = number of Pathos Traits you are attempting to recharge). You may not undercharge an item \u2014 when it is created it has a set charge and you must recharge it completely or not at all. Should you fail, the item will permanently lose one level of the number of Pathos it can hold. Note: these losses are cumulative and may lower the Pathos below what the item needs to activate, effectively destroying the item."}, {"Level": 3, "Name": "Minor Creation", "Description": "This power allows the caster to soulforge an item with an innate or basic Arcanoi of a type that the wraith being soulforged possessed. This power takes an entire night and costs 1 Willpower and a Point of Blood per Point of Pathos to be held by the item being created. At the end of the night, make a Social Challenge vs triple the Blood being expended. Success means the item now carries Max Pathos, and that Pathos may be used by the attuned individual to activate the Arcanoi held in the item."}, {"Level": 4, "Name": "Moderate Creation", "Description": "Functions as Minor Creation except with Intermediate Arcanoi. This power costs 2 Blood and 2 Willpower."}, {"Level": 5, "Name": "Major Creation", "Description": "Functions as both creation powers except with Advanced Arcanoi. This power costs 3 Blood and 3 Willpower."}]

rows.Description: This path is all about the necromancer exchanging favors with wraiths to garner strength by binding the wraith to themselves for a set buff. The necromancer usually does these favors for the dead in advance so they will be prepared when the need arises. These favors are minimal to begin with and become greater the greater the benefits needed. Any use of this power manifests on the user as a ghostly tattoo or marking somewhere on the caster's body. The willingness of the Wraith to trade favors is built by helping fulfill the wraith's passions over a period of time: Minor Favor = 3 nights (Basic), Major Favor = 3 weeks (Intermediate), Greater Favor = 3 months (Advanced). Calling in the Favor binds the wraith to you for the following night (except Eternal Gratitude). Up to your path rating in wraiths can be temporarily attached to you at all times.
rows.Levels: [{"Level": 1, "Name": "Learning from the Past", "Description": "Many wraiths retain histories or lores that the necromancer could find useful. This power allows the necromancer to absorb knowledge of a specific lore from a wraith for the next scene or hour. System: Spend a blood and get up to the second level in a lore given by an indebted wraith for the next scene or hour as the wraith temporarily binds itself to the caster. This does not bypass the approval process. STs are encouraged to use their best judgment when this power is being used and whether the lore selected would work well for their game."}, {"Level": 2, "Name": "Shared Strength", "Description": "At this level the necromancer is utilizing the most basic connection with the dead to augment their own traits to better complete their goals. The necromancer makes a minor deal with the wraith to allow them to augment one trait category by 2 for the next scene or hour. System: Spend a blood trait and get 2 traits in a single category given by an indebted wraith for the next scene or hour. This augment will last a number of rounds equal to the necromancer's path rating. This does not bypass the approval process."}, {"Level": 3, "Name": "Learning from the Masters", "Description": "The necromancer utilizes a larger debt to convince the wraiths to assist. The dead can be master gunslingers, hackers, etc. \u2014 traits that a necromancer might not be efficient at \u2014 so this level allows the necromancer to lean on the wraith's actual abilities and utilize them as if they were their own. System: Spend a blood and add two levels in a non-lore ability given by an indebted wraith for a number of rounds equal to the necromancer's path rating as the wraith temporarily binds itself to the caster. If the Storyteller and Chronicle allow it, this could go beyond the fifth level of the non-lore ability. This does not bypass the approval process."}, {"Level": 4, "Name": "Come to Me", "Description": "The dead are not stuck with only the knowledges they had when they were living but can also learn the powers of their new existence. This level allows the necromancer to utilize the actual powers of the wraith. System: The caster spends a blood and a willpower to garner the use of one power from the wraith (not to exceed advanced) given by an indebted wraith for the next scene or hour as the wraith temporarily binds itself to the caster. To utilize any powers that require Pathos the caster must spend a temp willpower to supplement the pathos cost. This does not bypass the approval process."}, {"Level": 5, "Name": "Eternal Gratitude", "Description": "Through the mastery of this path the caster has learned how to extend the benefits of the gratitude of the spirits of the dead into a permanent augmentation. This functions much as the path of spirit thaumaturgy does for items, but for the necromancer's body instead of items. After performing a grand feat to assist the wraith in the skin lands (avenging them, saving their true love, providing stability for their descendants, etc.) and expending a willpower, the wraith agrees to serve the necromancer permanently. System: Spend a blood and a willpower trait and bind an indebted wraith to the caster, applying the benefits of the lower levels of this power. The necromancer can only have a number of wraiths bound to them this way equal to their primary path (max 5), cannot utilize any individual level benefit more than three times, and cannot utilize the same specific benefit twice (e.g., if getting 2 athletics from level 5, cannot also get 2 more athletics from level 3, but can get 2 athletics from level 5 and 2 crafts from level 3). The caster must expend a permanent willpower to attune this power."}]

rows.Description: The exact origins of this path of Dur-An-Ki are obscured in the mists of time. Some say that Al-Ashrad developed it after the clan's warrior caste's curse at the hands of the Baali. Other rumors are told that this path was incepted by an infernalist Sorcerer who managed to break his bonds of demonic slavery. Unless otherwise noted, the powers of Ex Inferis are retested with the Theology ability. [OWbN Dur-An-Ki Packet, originally from www.Assamites.com]
rows.Levels: [{"Level": 1, "Name": "Pervideo (Survey)", "Description": "Before you can fight the taint of the infernal, you must first find it. The first level of Ex Inferis enables the Sorcerer to locate infernalists in his vicinity. MET Conversion: The Sorcerer makes a static Mental Challenge with a difficulty of the target's current Mental Traits; if successful, the Sorcerer may ask the target player if his or her character is 'currently under the influence of any Infernal Taint' and receive a truthful answer. If used on an individual employing Obfuscate or other such power, the Sorcerer still may throw the challenge, but will only know that an Infernalist is in the vicinity if successful. Note: Investments which hide Infernalism (such as Mask of Innocence) will nullify this power's effectiveness."}, {"Level": 2, "Name": "Venatio (The Chase)", "Description": "Infernalists that have been spotted rarely stick around to suffer their righteous punishment. The movements of infernalists discovered by use of Pervideo can be tracked by this power. MET Conversion: On the same night that the Sorcerer has successfully detected an infernalist with Pervideo, he may cast Venatio. The Sorcerer engages the target in a Mental Challenge (defender retests with Subterfuge). If successful, a trail of light indicating the infernalist's traveled path will be visible to the Sorcerer for the next scene or hour. If the target is Obfuscated or otherwise supernaturally concealed, the trail will still lead to the current location of the Infernalist. While this power is in effect the infernalist will experience a continuous feeling of being watched."}, {"Level": 3, "Name": "Adversor (Oppose)", "Description": "Upon attaining this level the Sorcerer can invoke a warding sphere against infernal creatures. Infernalists and demon-possessed beings coming into contact with this ward will be expelled and will suffer intense pain and even injury. MET Conversion: Spend a Willpower in addition to the normal cost to activate Adversor. When active, it extends 10 feet around the Sorcerer, and is stationary. Any Infernalist with active Investments or Infernal powers attempting to pass into the warding sphere, already inside the sphere when it is cast, or attempting to affect the area within the warded zone with Infernal powers must succeed in a contested Mental Challenge against the Sorcerer. If the infernalist wins, the ward is broken. If the Sorcerer wins, the infernalist suffers three levels of lethal damage and will be physically expelled from the warding sphere. The sphere lasts for the scene or hour unless the Sorcerer decides to end the power sooner."}, {"Level": 4, "Name": "Nominatim (By Name)", "Description": "The greatest weapon of war is information. With this power the Sorcerer can discover the name of the demonic patron the infernalist is enslaved to. This name can then be used for other sorcerous powers. MET Conversion: The Sorcerer must first have spotted the infernalist through Pervideo and must have direct line of sight when invoking this power. The Sorcerer may then engage the target in a Mental Challenge (defender uses Subterfuge to retest). If successful, the Sorcerer may spend Mental Traits to discover information: 1 Mental Trait reveals the Infernalist's demonic master's 'Nature' (Lust, Pride, Greed, etc.); 2 Mental Traits reveal Nature and Primary Name; 3 Mental Traits reveal Nature, Primary Name, and a vague indication of the demon's power. The demonic master is more sensitive to such inquiries and may become aware it is being looked into, especially if it feels its identity has been compromised. This power can be used only once per lunar month on an infernalist."}, {"Level": 5, "Name": "Periurium (Break the Oath)", "Description": "If a Sorcerer has successfully discovered the name of the infernalist's demonic patron, they can temporarily sever the connection between the infernalist and its master, robbing the infernalist of its investments and demonic power. MET Conversion: The Sorcerer must spend a Willpower in addition to the normal activation cost, then enter into a Mental Challenge with the infernalist (who may defend with Subterfuge). If successful, the caster may further spend Willpower to strip the Infernalist of investments or powers given by the identified demon: 1 Willpower = 1 round, 2 Willpower = 1 scene, 3 Willpower = 1 hour, 4 Willpower = the rest of the night. The infernalist and demonic master are both immediately aware if this power is attempted, successful or not."}]

rows.Description:
A Hermetic path focused on enhancing and transforming the caster's visual perception through progressive eye modifications. Each level changes the caster's eye appearance noticeably. When multiple levels are stacked, the highest level's appearance is apparent. The caster can end any of the effects at will.

Cross-reference: This path also appears in the OWBN Archivist database under the name 'PATH OF EYES' (Archivist entry #25698). The content is identical; only the entry title and capitalization differ.
rows.Levels: [{"Level": 1, "Name": "Gray Sight", "Description": "Cost: 1 Blood. Up 2 traits on all visual-related challenges for an hour or scene. Cannot stack multiple uses. Eye appearance: iris turns gray (fairly Masquerade safe)."}, {"Level": 2, "Name": "Cat Sight", "Description": "Cost: 1 Blood. Grants same benefits as Eyes of the Beast plus the negative trait Bestial due to eye appearance. Lasts an hour or a scene. Eye appearance: iris becomes gold and green flecked with cat-like pupils (best covered by sunglasses)."}, {"Level": 3, "Name": "Eagle Sight", "Description": "Cost: 1 Blood. See three times as far as normal, or magnify small objects up to three times. Can be combined with other visual perception powers. Lasts one hour or a scene. Eye appearance: completely gold iris with silver pupil (not Masquerade safe)."}, {"Level": 4, "Name": "Shroud Sight", "Description": "Cost: 1 Blood. As Shroud Sight except with a slightly disorienting double sight imposing the negative trait Oblivious while active. Lasts an hour or a scene. Eye appearance: entire eye completely white (potential Masquerade breach)."}, {"Level": 5, "Name": "Void Sight", "Description": "Cost: 1 Blood. Win on ties for all visual perception challenges. Immune to the first two levels of Obtenebration and all vision-related illusions formed by the first four levels of Chimestry. Gain the social trait Intimidating to those who can see the caster's eyes. Eye appearance: eye becomes completely black (extremely Masquerade unsafe)."}]

rows.Description: Long ago the August Personage of Jade chose 10,000 heroes to protect against the depravity of the Yama Kings. These heroes would undergo tests that would awaken their Chi and allow them to contend with terrors by assuming the God Body. The Sons of Kaali seek to emulate these heroes through Meditation and prayer. To achieve the God Body requires a full round of concentration, along with the expenditure of three Blood and one Willpower, and remains active for one hour. While active, the character gains a number of bonus Agile physical traits equal to half their rating (rounded up) in Assuming the God Body. Each level also grants a single ability that is always active while in God Body form. The God Body is considered a form for the purposes of transformation powers. This Path may only be used once per night. The change in appearance should always be dramatic and Masquerade-violating.
rows.Levels: [{"Level": 1, "Name": "Treading Upon the Wind", "Description": "While this power is active, the character seems to be able to walk, run or leap on thin air, maneuvering in three dimensions. System: They can walk or run up to any height and catch themselves if they fall with a Static Physical Challenge, retesting with Athletics at a difficulty equal to the local Gauntlet. Their leaping distance is increased by their levels in Assuming the God Body in yards."}, {"Level": 2, "Name": "Flowing Like Blood", "Description": "The character moves as if blinking in and out of existence with a degree of technique simply beyond human. System: While Assuming the God Body is active, the character may spend a point of blood at the beginning of the round to attune himself to an opponent. They gain a free retest to all Dodge challenges while in combat against them. Their body moves reflexively to evade attacks \u2014 changing who they are attuned to requires the expenditure of a Willpower at the beginning of any round they wish to designate a new target."}, {"Level": 3, "Name": "Shattering The Mountain", "Description": "The character delivers blows that smash through engine blocks and steel doors with awe-inspiring ease. System: Whether unarmed or using a melee weapon, the character's attacks deal additional damage equal to the character's levels in Assuming the God Body. This damage may only be applied to spirits, inanimate objects, and levels of armor."}, {"Level": 4, "Name": "Awakening The Ivory Mantle", "Description": "At this stage, the character's control over their perfected form allows them to harden, twist and bend their bones at will, charging them with a ghostly flame that protects against spirits, demons and magic, and allows bone spurs to sprout from their flesh in the form of foot-long talons from either or both hands. System: While Assuming the God Body is active, the character reduces damage from magic sources, demons and spirits by a number of levels equal to half their rating in Assuming the God Body (rounded up), to a minimum of a single level of damage, applied after any other sources. Furthermore, the character may spend one point of Willpower to manifest long, razor-sharp bone claws. Attacks made with these claws deal an extra health level and the damage is lethal."}, {"Level": 5, "Name": "Stoking the Ghost Flame", "Description": "The character's attacks may now channel Yin and Yang energies. After striking an opponent with either an unarmed attack or a melee weapon, the character may choose to spend one blood and make a Simple Challenge. On a win or tie the target is engulfed in the character's Chi. If the character chooses Yin, the target suffers the Lethargic negative trait as energy is drained from them. The subject may end this effect by using a turn to make a Static Stamina-related Physical challenge at a difficulty equal to the character's physical traits, retesting with Occult. If the character chooses Yang, the target ignites and catches fire, dealing one additional level of aggravated damage and one more at the end of each turn, plus forcing a Courage test at difficulty 3 (failure = Rotschreck). The subject may end the effects by using their turn to make two Simple challenges \u2014 if both are won, the effect ends."}]

rows.Description:
This path duplicates legends of Jewish faith, namely the creation myths of Golems. Statues must be created in advance and are not created by the path itself. Golems have no Mentals or Socials and cannot be affected by Dominate, Animalism, or Presence. They are treated as objects, not creatures. Stone golems gain +2 physical traits and +1 health level but move at 2 steps/action. Metal gains +4 physical and +2 health levels but moves 1 step/action.

Cross-reference: See also 'Path of Animation' (also in OWBN Custom Paths), which covers similar golem animation mechanics. Both entries are preserved for completeness.
rows.Levels: [{"Level": 1, "Name": "Tiny Homunculus", "Description": "Animate small constructs the size of a Homunculus. Lasts a maximum of seven days. 4 Physical traits, 3 health levels, 4 abilities (instinctual only: melee, brawl, dodge). Cost: 1 blood, 1 action."}, {"Level": 2, "Name": "Small Animal", "Description": "Animate slightly larger statues such as cats or small dogs. Still lasts a maximum of seven days. 6 physical traits, 5 health levels, 6 abilities (no single ability above five dots). Cost: 1 blood, 1 action."}, {"Level": 3, "Name": "Human Sized", "Description": "Animate human-sized statues or similarly-sized animals. All animations now last up to a full month. Capabilities available (flying, increased damage, etc.). 8 physical traits, 7 health levels, 10 abilities. Cost: 2 blood, 1 action."}, {"Level": 4, "Name": "Large Creature", "Description": "Animate the largest statues this path can handle \u2014 Grizzly bear, Rhinoceros, Giraffe, or similar. 10 physical traits, 9 health levels, 14 abilities. Cost: 2 blood, 1 action."}, {"Level": 5, "Name": "Master Animator", "Description": "All animations last up to six months and may be granted a second capability. Physical traits equal to 10 + 2x Occult rating or Crafts level (whichever higher). 12 health levels, 20 ability points (max 5 in any ability, no abilities requiring Mentals or Socials). Cost: 3 blood, 2 actions."}]

rows.Description: This Path is born out of a deep understanding of Hermetic Thaumaturgy and works in conjunction with other hermetic magic. As such it does not require activation but is always in effect. Your maximum level of Hermetic Proficiency is equal to the number of Hermetic Paths you have at Advanced, with the highest level being Advanced.
rows.Levels: [{"Level": 1, "Name": "Fine Tuning", "Description": "With this power you can fine tune the cosmetic appearance and tertiary effects of your Thaumaturgy Paths and rituals. You cannot make your Thaumaturgy more powerful, though it may be more utilitarian or subtle, and changes are up to the ST. For example, you could make your Lure of Flame appear as blue lasers, make visible waves of force with Movement of the Mind, make an itch become a tickle, or a cold chill become a warm flush. The description of your change should not take more than one sentence."}, {"Level": 2, "Name": "Mantle of Spells", "Description": "Each night, for every mastered Hermetic Path you know, you may cast one ritual on yourself without a test."}, {"Level": 3, "Name": "Expeditious Casting", "Description": "Depending on your mastery of magic you can cast magic faster. If you have mastered 3 Paths you may cast rituals in half the time. If you have mastered 5 Paths you may cast rituals in a third of the time. If you have mastered 7 Paths you may cast rituals in a tenth of the time. Certain offensive/attack rituals (such as Night of the Red Heart) may still take their full time at ST discretion. Additionally, Path levels considered a 'buff' can now be cast without taking an action."}, {"Level": 4, "Name": "Hermetic Dominance", "Description": "Each night you may call a 'Magic Proficiency' discipline retest for every two Advanced levels of Hermetic Thaumaturgy you possess. These retests can only be called in tests involving magic (not just Hermetic) either offensively or defensively, and may only be used once per challenge, similar to a Might or Awe retest."}, {"Level": 5, "Name": "Hermetic Magnification", "Description": "Such is your mastery of Hermetic magic that you can enhance the power of individual Paths of Magic. You may choose ONE of the following benefits that apply when using a level of a Hermetic Path or Ritual: (1) Deal one extra level of damage of the same type; (2) Double the amount of time an effect lasts; (3) Halve the cost (round down, minimum of one) in blood and/or mentals of any power. Note that Hermetic Magnification may not apply to all levels of Thaumaturgy and the ST may determine that specific effects are not appropriate or too powerful."}]

rows.Description: Indra is the king of Svarga (Heaven) and the Devas. He is the god of the heavens, lightning, thunderstorms, rains and river flows, celebrated for his powers and for killing the great symbolic evil Vritra who obstructs human prosperity and happiness. A Sadhana practitioner who uses this path channels the Divine powers of Indra.
rows.Levels: [{"Level": 1, "Name": "Providence", "Description": "This ability calls upon the Goddess Providence which gives Indra his strength and virility to accomplish his deeds. The Sadhana practitioner calls upon a small bit of this power and enhances the caster with the ability to heal faster. System: The Character may spend 1 blood a round beyond their generational maximum to heal one level of lethal or bashing damage."}, {"Level": 2, "Name": "Libations of Soma", "Description": "All the Gods drank healthily but none as much as Indra, who was renowned for his intake of libations. It fortified him in his fights. This path allows one to drink of the storm which is Indra's strength and fortify oneself from its libations. System: The character may spend 1 full action to stand in the rain, soaking in the water. After which they may gain 3 blood traits as if they were feeding. This may be done once a turn. A Character may not gain more than 10 blood traits a night from this power."}, {"Level": 3, "Name": "Heaven's Wide Space", "Description": "Being the God of the storm, rain, lightning and thunder, Indra was considered the God of the heavens and could command them to bend to his will. Those blessed by Indra are able to channel some of that power and bend an area of the heavens to their will. System: Spend 1 blood and call upon a rainstorm. The time for the storm to gather is 5 minutes but may be decreased by 1 minute per social trait spent at the time of casting (max 5). Those caught in the storm are down two traits in all challenges related to eyesight. The storm is limited in size to a City Block or The Scene. Anything within the range of the storm is to be considered to be within line of sight."}, {"Level": 4, "Name": "Hawk's Flight", "Description": "Being the God of the heavens and thus the storm allowed Indra to travel within them as he traverses across the realms. Hawk's Flight allows you to channel this blessed power and fly through the storm. System: The caster may move like they are part of the storm, flying through it at up to 45 miles per hour. As long as you stay within the storm you can fly continuously with no more expenditure than the original Willpower to take off. You can carry yourself and up to 200 pounds more. Once outside the storm you will start to lose velocity and descend to the ground."}, {"Level": 5, "Name": "Cleft in Twain", "Description": "Indra was a fighter with no equal and a hero who fought the Dragon, with strikes so potent they split a mountain in half. Cleft in Twain allows one to travel the storm in lightning-quick movement and even strike your target with the strength of Indra. System: Those Blessed by Indra move like him and fight like him. At a cost of a Willpower you may move like lightning to your target in a physical strike, dealing 5 aggravated damage as a hammer made of lightning appears in your hands and descends upon your target. This requires a physical challenge against your target retested with Occult. Distance is limited to the size of the storm. Target is limited to line of sight."}]

rows.Description: Not all battles happen in the streets or even on a typical battlefield. Some battles are fought and won within buildings. Urban warfare is a warfront that thaumaturgists have the hardest time with because most magic is painfully obvious as magic. With Innkeeper, the thaumaturgist taps into the side of war that is urban combat. They become adept at fighting inside buildings, and this benefit increases in buildings they are intimately familiar with. To be considered attuned to a building the Thaumaturge must have spent 3 consecutive days sleeping in the building or have an alternative means of mystically attuning to it. All levels require the expenditure of 1 blood to activate.
rows.Levels: [{"Level": 1, "Name": "Weapons at the Ready", "Description": "Being disarmed can mean life and death, but being in a building means there are always weapons to be found. A chair or table leg can be broken off and used as a club, a drawer may have a knife or letter opener. The thaumaturge is always able to re-arm themselves immediately upon being disarmed as the house will provide them a new weapon. Regardless of the actual item provided, statistically it will always be a 2 Traits, 2 Lethal, 0 negative trait weapon. At the end of this power any items provided revert to their usual statistics. If used in a building the thaumaturge is attuned to, the item is instead a 3 trait, 2 lethal, 0 negative trait weapon with high caliber. Once active, this power is on for the scene."}, {"Level": 2, "Name": "Kill the Witch", "Description": "A mob, unlike an individual or matching size party, is much easier to fight in a building. The mob has to both attempt to get to their target and keep out of each other's way. They will try to go through doors at the same time, swing and foul another's shot, and so forth. So long as the thaumaturge is outnumbered, they will have an additional retest in all defensive challenges, limited to the number of aggressors or 5, whichever is less. This benefit is lost if they are no longer outnumbered. If they become outnumbered again, or have used all available retests, they may reactivate this power. If used in a building the thaumaturge is attuned to, the power provides the thaumaturge a bonus retest in all defensive challenges for the scene or hour."}, {"Level": 3, "Name": "House Mouse", "Description": "Every mouse has its bolt holes and knows the lay of the land it lives in. The thaumaturge is most comfortable in the enclosed environment of halls and rooms, allowing them to move easier because they know the exact distance of every part of the building. So long as the thaumaturge is in a building, they are up 2 traits in all physical, social, and mental challenges. If it is a building they are intimately familiar with (attuned to), they are instead up 3 traits. This benefit can only be used in one trait category per round."}, {"Level": 4, "Name": "Lockdown", "Description": "Being able to barricade a room to create a controlled environment for fighting or to keep others from getting to you can mean the difference between survival or death. With this power the thaumaturge's willpower becomes that barricade. The Thaumaturge can bar the exits of a room even if there are no physical doors or window-like things to bar the way. Anyone attempting to break in/out of a locked room must make a contested Willpower challenge against the caster, retest Security. The Thaumaturge gets a free retest for this power if enacted in a building they are attuned to. Additionally, those attempting to leave the room via non-physical means automatically win on ties. Attempting to enter the room in this fashion, however, is as per physically entering and does not automatically win on ties."}, {"Level": 5, "Name": "Explosive Demise", "Description": "In every fight there is that moment when you realize things have gone sideways and it is time to pull the pin and toss the grenade. Instead of physically pulling the pin, the thaumaturge will pull the magical pin and use the room as its grenade. First, spend a temporary Willpower trait in addition to the blood point required. Then, risk a number of Mental traits equal to no more than 3 (or no more than 6 in a building to which you are attuned) and make a static Mental challenge difficulty 10 (difficulty 7 in an attuned building), retest with Occult. If successful, an explosion tears through the room ripping electrical lines, water pipes, gas pipes out of the wall and setting the room aflame for a brief moment, dealing aggravated damage to all targets equal to the traits risked. The concussive force sends everyone in the room prone (spending a point of Athletics can prevent falling). This power does not differentiate between friend and foe. The flames will last through the end of the round if not otherwise extinguished. If used on a room secured by Lockdown, the force of this path's magic being turned back on itself causes the metaphysical barriers of Lockdown to fall. Note: In order to not have to be within the room upon activation or have line of sight of the room, the Thaumaturge MUST be attuned to the building. If not attuned, they must either have line of sight or be physically present in the room and suffer the consequences."}]

rows.Description:
A versatile path created by a self-proclaimed Druidic Dur-An-Ki practitioner, finding its roots in the folklore of moon gods and lunar magic.

Cross-reference: See also 'Path of Draiocht Gealach' (also in OWBN Custom Paths), which is the same path submitted under a different name for Assamite Sorcery (Dur-An-Ki). Both entries are preserved for completeness.
rows.Levels: [{"Level": 1, "Name": "By The Pale Moonlight", "Description": "Spend a blood. A nimbus of moonlight surrounds the character, enabling them and nearby allies to see clearly in the darkest conditions. Radiates up to 20 feet around the character. You gain the ability Luminous which may cancel the Darkness retest. Lasts for a scene or an hour."}, {"Level": 2, "Name": "Reach For The Stars", "Description": "Spend a blood at the beginning of the round. While within the moonlit shroud of By The Pale Moonlight, the caster may blink to anywhere within the 20 illuminated feet, returning to the original starting point at end of round or remaining at the new location by reactivating the previous level. Grants a Surprise retest on the next attack the first time used in a scene."}, {"Level": 3, "Name": "Blood Makes Noise", "Description": "Spend a blood and a willpower while radiating Luna's glow. Choose to either lessen blood pressure (heal one aggravated wound in your presence) or increase it (cause an additional level of bashing damage added on each subsequent attack of the round). Lasts only one round and requires By The Pale Moonlight to be active."}, {"Level": 4, "Name": "Moonglades", "Description": "Spend a blood to identify a sacred area attuned to Luna. Spend a willpower to attune yourself to the location for one lunar cycle. Within your Moonglade: gain Heightened Senses: Sight for free, and may spend willpower to retest attempts to break Obfuscate or Chimerstry. With a permanent willpower, step between any Moonglades attuned to you (takes two consecutive rounds)."}, {"Level": 5, "Name": "Luna's Wrath", "Description": "Spend three blood and a willpower to assume a mythical creature form whose aura radiates moonlight. Gain two Bonus Physical Traits (Fierce and Energetic), the Merit Huge Size, and the Merit Lucky for the remainder of the scene. At the end of the scene, suffer Negative Physical Trait Frail x3 and the Derangement Schizophrenia for the remainder of the night. May only be used once per game."}]

rows.Blood Magic Category: Voudoun Wanga - Serpents of the Light
rows.Description:
Just as the primordial Obatala separated the sea from the land and the earth from the sky, so too did he separate the light from the darkness and everything from nothing. The void, the emptiness left behind by these acts of creation, reflects its own primordial Orisha, Oranayra. His favored number is 9 (and its multiples), his favored colors are pure black and pure white, and his festivals are on December 21st. Few enough practitioners still worship him, and those who do are most commonly bokor rather than houngans. By offering up a sacrifice of oneself to Oranayra, in this case through the gift of blood, the practitioner is able to make use of that divine channel in order to act as a sort of doorway into the void. In this way, a Cainite can in essence empower themselves to consume much more than they normally could, both in quantity and in scope.

Whenever a level of this path is used, their surroundings warp in the presence of the opened doorway that they represent. This manifests as a sort of environmental attraction. Air currents stream towards and end at the Cainite and disappear, flames lean in their direction, and even shadows will bend from their normal course to point towards the practitioner.
rows.Levels:
[{"Level": 1, "Name": "Draught of Memory", "Description": "The Kindred spends one round drinking at least one trait of Blood from a target. The caster may inform the Storyteller of a piece of information they are attempting to search for, and make a Static Mental Challenge against the victim's Mental Traits. The wangateur is considered to have one additional trait for the purpose of ties in this challenge for each trait of blood beyond the first they consume. If the challenge is successful and the victim possesses the knowledge, the vampire gains the information sought, which is stored in the consumed vitae. This information lasts only until the Kindred spends the Blood Trait(s) that holds the memory, at which point it fades from their mind. At Storyteller's discretion, this information might be represented by the temporary gain of Ability traits. Temporary traits gained in this manner can never be raised to a higher level than the target possessed. If the practitioner diablerizes their victim in the process, the information they gain is retained permanently (the Storyteller may opt to allow the wangateur to spend Experience to permanently purchase any Ability Traits gained, if the character has the experience on hand at the time of the diablerie)."}, {"Level": 2, "Name": "The Bottomless Well", "Description": "A practitioner with this power is capable of gorging themselves on blood in much the same way Oranayra ceaselessly devours all that is fed to him. Their open channel with the Orisha even leads to his ravenous appetite spilling out into the Cainite slightly.

System: The Kindred spends one full round in concentration, then makes a Static Physical Challenge against a difficulty equal to the number of Blood Traits currently in his pool. If successful, for the following scene they become capable of drinking twice as much blood per round as they would otherwise be able to. Ordinarily, this means a Kindred becomes capable of consuming six Blood a round from their victim, though some truly monstrous practitioners have been rumored to drink more. As with normal feeding, the Cainite's fangs must successfully pierce their victim's flesh to obtain their sanguine prize and thus enough Fortitude may well stave off the would-be predator temporarily. This does not affect the size of the Cainite's Blood Pool, however. While The Bottomless Well is active, the caster suffers a one-Trait penalty to resist frenzy resulting from exposure to blood."}, {"Level": 3, "Name": "Drawing the Soul", "Description": "There have been tales of Cainites capable of consuming the souls of others merely by drinking their blood. This power may have contributed its fair share to those rumors, for with exacting concentration, a practitioner becomes capable of imbibing their target's strength of will as simply as if it were vitae.

System: Over the course of three full rounds of concentration, the caster opens themselves up to the near-complete pull of Oranayra's emptiness. For the next scene the caster gains 1 Trait of Willpower, drained from their victim, for every three traits of Blood consumed. This can only be done when imbibing blood directly from a sentient creature (one which possesses Willpower), which prevents binge-drinking blood bags for a motivational pick-me-up. These Willpower Traits cannot exceed the caster's generational maximum; any they gain which exceed their limit simply disappear."}, {"Level": 4, "Name": "Call of the Void", "Description": "The penultimate expression of Oranayra's monstrous urges, the practitioner enhances their diablerie of other Cainites, and even becomes capable of consuming the very souls of other sentient beings just as if they were a Cainite themselves. Most practitioners believe that while they do gain some benefits from the consumption of the soul of another, its final destination is Oranayra.

System: When diablerizing a Cainite, the caster spends a single Willpower Trait. The diablerist may treat their victim as a teacher for a single level of one non-blood sorcery, Discipline the victim was capable of teaching. To diablerize a non-kindred victim, the caster must first fully drain their victim of blood, usually through assistance by earlier powers in this path. Immediately after the victim's last Blood Trait leaves their pool, the caster spends a Willpower Trait and begins the process of diablerie exactly as though their victim were a Kindred. If successful, the caster consumes the victim's soul for themselves, making it a part of them. The process of diablerizing supernatural creatures other than Cainites grants no mechanical benefits aside from those normally associated with diablerie."}, {"Level": 5, "Name": "Defiance of Oranayra", "Description": "In an unprecedented act of defiance against Oranayra, the most accomplished practitioners are able to strengthen the divine channel between them and the Orisha with additional sacrifices of blood and sheer force of will, keeping it open long enough to reclaim some of what oblivion has consumed.

System: The Cainite spends 3 Blood Traits and a Willpower Trait in order to regurgitate a soul they have diablerized. The loss of this soul is accompanied by the loss of any benefits or drawbacks that particular diablerie instilled, with the exception of any Morality loss for committing the act. The caster must defeat the spirit in a Contested Willpower Challenge in order to compel them into service, and the spirit receives a free retest on this challenge as a result of its sheer hatred over having been consumed. The disembodied soul manifests as a black and purple, shadowy spirit for the remainder of the scene, and it can interact with those nearby for the remainder of the scene before the pull of Oranayra reclaims what was taken from it and the spirit returns to Oblivion. During this time, the soul can be affected by Necromancy as if it were a wraith. The soul can interact with its environment in any way that its original could have, using the same traits as its original, and maintains a rudimentary memory of its previous existence. However, souls in such a state bear no sense of motivation or initiative. It acts purely and solely according to the wangateur's will."}]

rows.Description: Conversion of the MET Faith and Fire version of Ogham to Assamite Sorcery (Dur-An-Ki).

Designed for walking through realms out of reach to Cainites, this Yin-aspect Eastern Necromancy path is a Necromantic interpretation of the Wraith Arcanos Argos. Practitioners permanently gain the Desensitization derangement which cannot be bought off. Levels may never be activated during combat.

Cross-reference: See also 'The Path Beyond' (also in OWBN Custom Paths), which is the same content submitted with the article prefix. Both entries are preserved for completeness.
rows.Levels: [{"Level": 1, "Name": "Watch the Wending", "Description": "Spend a point of Willpower to become in tune with the nearby Tempest or Far Shore, gaining a sense of nearby dangers, hidden pathways, or strange laws governing the realm. Work with Storyteller for degrees of understanding; some secrets may require a Cosmology test."}, {"Level": 2, "Name": "Donning the Phantom Cloak", "Description": "Spend a point of Willpower to conjure a ghostly cloak. While wearing it, the character suffers no damage or debilitating effects from the Maelstrom or Tempest. At Storyteller discretion, these protections extend to the environmental dangers of the Far Shores."}, {"Level": 3, "Name": "Walking Beyond", "Description": "Spend a point of Willpower and make a physical challenge at difficulty 8. If successful, the character passes into the Tempest without opening a Nihil."}, {"Level": 4, "Name": "Sojourn", "Description": "Spend a Willpower and make a Static Mental challenge at difficulty 8. If successful, collapse into a cold black wind and safely pass into the Tempest, then use physical challenges to journey to other places (Stygia, Far Shores). Greatly reduces the distance traveled; never takes a character more than 100 miles to an earthly destination."}, {"Level": 5, "Name": "The Walker in Darkness", "Description": "While in the Tempest, spend a point of Willpower to instantaneously travel to any Far Shore already visited or any Underworld location previously visited, provided it has no reflection in the Skinlands. Intended for travel to dark and mysterious locations, not as a shortcut to mundane places."}]

rows.Description: Zoroastrian beliefs emphasize walking the dark path of Angra Mainyu in order to more fully appreciate and give value to the decision to turn back to the path of Ahura Mazda. Developed to represent methods of Angra Mainyu that can be turned to good purpose. Retests with the Occult Ability.
rows.Levels: [{"Level": 1, "Name": "Second-Story Work", "Description": "This power allows the Ashipu to compel a door, latch, or other mechanism to lock or unlock itself, and to open or close itself. If the portal is sealed in some supernatural fashion, the sorcerer must first succeed in a Static Mental Challenge against the Mental Traits of the protection's creator."}, {"Level": 2, "Name": "Stir to Silence", "Description": "Render any object or subject incapable of generating sound (including indirect noise). Make a Static Mental Challenge to affect objects, or a Contested Mental Challenge to affect any living or unliving creature. This enforced silence lasts for a single scene or hour unless ended early by the caster."}, {"Level": 3, "Name": "Rogue's Gallery", "Description": "Cause any object or collection of associated objects (up to the size of a medium car) to appear to be some other object of roughly similar size. Only appearance changes, not function. Lasts for a scene or hour. Those using Heightened Senses to investigate discrepancies may do so with a Mental Challenge against the caster."}, {"Level": 4, "Name": "One Size Fits All", "Description": "Cause an object to shrink to up to one tenth its original dimensions and weight over a full turn of concentration. Any inanimate object can be affected, even mystical items. Sentient creatures directly harmed by the reduction are instead displaced to the nearest safe area. The sorcerer may undo this reduction at any time."}, {"Level": 5, "Name": "Invoke Duplicity", "Description": "Make a Static Mental Challenge against a target, then make all necessary challenges to pickpocket an item from them or place an item on their person. If the initial challenge is successful, the target does not notice or acknowledge the interaction. If performed from supernatural stealth (such as Obfuscate), a successful static challenge prevents the stealth from being broken."}]

rows.Description:
This path duplicates some of the legends of the Jewish faith. Namely the creation myths of Golem's. As the caster gains proficiency they can animate larger and more complex golem's, allowing them to have different capabilities. Statue's must be created in advance, they are not created by the path, however, as long as they have not been destroyed the same statue can be reanimated repeatedly by the path user. Any damage to statues that has not been repaired between path usages is not repaired by the path itself. None of the animations of this path have mentals or socials, and they cannot be affected by Dominate, Animalism, Presence, and similar powers because of this. Also, they tend to take orders quite literally because of the lack of mentals. As these are animated objects, rather than creatures, powers affect them as objects. Powers that affect creatures cannot be used on them, but powers that affect objects can. Anything that affects both creatures and objects will work on them as well. Most golem's are made from traditional materials like clay and mud. Alternate materials may be utilized, but will only affect physical traits and health levels, not grant additional powers or capabilities.

Mechanics: The path shows traditional clay/mud golems for reference. Stone receives an additional +2 physical traits and +1 health level, but loses speed, moving at only 2 steps/action. Metal receives an additional +4 physical traits and +2 health levels, but loses even more speed, moving only 1 step/action. Pottery receives a loss of 1 physical trait and 1 health level, but being so much lighter it also moves faster, at 4 steps/action. Alternate materials not listed here can adjust health levels and physical traits, at ST discretion.

Cross-reference: This path substantially overlaps with 'Golem Path' (also in OWBN Custom Paths) in theme and mechanics. Both involve animating stone/clay constructs; Path of Animation originated in Northern Virginia (Night Falls) while Golem Path may differ in specific mechanical details. Both entries are preserved for completeness.
rows.Levels:
[{"Level": 1, "Name": "Level 1", "Description": "At this level the thaumaturge can only animate small constructs, truly tiny things the size of a Homunculus perhaps. The animation lasts a maximum of seven days.

Creatures this small have a total of 4 Physical traits, 3 health levels (Healthy, Bruised, Incapacitated), and a total of 4 abilities. No abilities may require thought, only instinctual things like melee, brawl, dodge, and similar "skills" may be selected.

Cost: 1 blood, 1 action"}, {"Level": 2, "Name": "Level 2", "Description": "At this level slightly larger statues can be animated, such as cats, small dogs, and things like komodo dragons or iguana's. The animations still only last a maximum of seven days.

Creatures this size have a total of 6 physical traits, five health levels (Healthy, Healthy, Bruised, Wounded, Incapacitated), and a total of 6 abilities, with the same restrictions as Level 1, and the added restriction that no single ability may have more than five dots.

Cost: 1 blood, 1 action"}, {"Level": 3, "Name": "Level 3", "Description": "At this level the thaumaturge may animate human sized statues. This includes animals of similar size, such as large dogs, wild cats, wolves, and small bears. All animations may last up to a full month once the thaumaturge reaches this level, and this increased duration applies to all lower levels as well. At this level capabilities are available as well, including flying, increased damage capabilities, water proofing, and similar abilities. All levels can be gifted with such capabilities, allowing for small flying birds with the lower levels of this power, for example.

Creatures this size have a total of 8 physical traits, seven health levels (same as normal human/vampire), and a total of 10 abilities, with the same restrictions as previous levels.
