In doing so, they have learned how Spirits are often devoured in Lupine Rites for Gnosis and Willpower, or how Spirits even eat one another for the same. The Thaumaturge that has learned this final level has mastered a similar technique. The ability to devour a Spirit and replenish their own Willpower. This is a potent power and risking it too often can have repercussions in both Spirit Noteriety and potentially loss of Humanity or development of Derangements as one takes in more and more alien power.
Mechanics: The Thaumaturge may attempt to devour a Spirit, they must make a Mental Challenge against a Difficulty set by the Storyteller, retest for this is Spirit Lore or Occult, the Spirit as always Retests with Essence. If successful, the Thaumaturge gains Half the Spirits Willpower. The Spirit is discorporated into the distant Umbra to reform as when any Spirit is destroyed. If the Thaumaturge used this power successfully more than once per lunar cycle they risk great potential harm. Their psyche is not meant to withstand the influx of such alien power on such a regular basis. It is recommended that the second use result in a temporary derangement of the STs choosing, preferably related to the Spirit Razed. A Third Use, may call for either Morality Tests or a Permanent Derangement at STs ruling. If this power is ever used on Ancestor Spirits it automatically requires an automatic loss of Humanity."}]

rows.Description: A sledgehammer of Karma, not a scalpel. Sadhu only call upon this path when a person gives them no other choice — after the target has turned away all attempts to walk their chosen Svdharma. With it, the sadhu can force the very change they seek in those they see as deviants in the web of fate.
rows.Levels: [{"Level": 1, "Name": "Mantra of Resonance", "Description": "The character must feed a willing target their blood. Spend 1 blood per ability trait conferred; the recipient gains those ability traits as if their own for the next scene or hour (each ability level requires one minute of casting per level). When gifting an ability the caster temporarily loses access to the same ability at the same level. Cannot gift abilities above level 5."}, {"Level": 2, "Name": "Thread of Fate", "Description": "Spend 1 blood and engage the target in a contested Social Challenge (retest Occult). If successful, change the target's Morality to one of the following for the next scene or hour: Eastern Paradox, Self-Focus, or Path of Devaraja. The target retains their Virtue levels (adopting new virtues at the same level if the chosen path requires different ones)."}, {"Level": 3, "Name": "Hand of Karma", "Description": "Spend 1 blood and make a contested Social Challenge (retest Occult). If successful, spend 1 permanent willpower to permanently change the nature of a target to one of the caster's choosing. After six months, the target may spend 1 permanent willpower to restore their original nature."}, {"Level": 4, "Name": "Tapestry's Consensus", "Description": "Spend 3 blood to activate for a scene or hour. Make a contested Social Challenge (retest Occult). If successful, the target cannot use any Inceptor or newly created Combination Disciplines or vampiric abilities (custom content) for the next scene or hour. In exchange, the caster also cannot use any custom content they possess during this time. Either party may spend 1 permanent willpower to use one custom power for a scene."}, {"Level": 5, "Name": "Karmic Retribution", "Description": "Spend 3 blood to activate for a scene or hour. Works in a room-sized area. Anyone inside must make a contested Willpower challenge against the caster if affected. If the target fails, they may only gain, use, or benefit from supernatural powers innate to vampires (Disciplines, Blood Magic, Combination Disciplines). Exception: Vampiric Descendants of Dracian may still use their Affinities (except any Affinity that grants another genre's powers). Only works on vampires."}]

rows.Description: A Hermetic path focused on sensing and manipulating earth and stone.
rows.Levels:
[{"Level": 1, "Name": "Sense Terra (Basic) - 4 XP", "Description": "Sense Terra allows the caster to detect the following for the scene within a 200 yard radius.
1. The composition of the earth within that area, including (but not limited to) precious metal.
2. Foreign objects in the ground, including manmade structures, but not what is in them
3. Caves and gaps in the ground."}, {"Level": 2, "Name": "Move Terra (Basic) - 4XP", "Description": "To use this power, the caster must first use Sense Terra. Once he can Sense an area, a caster may move up to a ton of earth at a slow walking pace. He can manipulate rock, soil, and the like, but not manmade / unnatural things in the earth. Things in the earth that are not natural may possibly be manipulated by moving the earth around them (i.e A bunker could not be made to contort or malformed, but might be damaged by slowly removing its supporting earth)."}, {"Level": 3, "Name": "Flow Terra (Intermediate) - 7XP", "Description": "At this level the caster can move earth with more force and precision that at precious levels. The caster can heave the earth with enough force to crack concrete.
The caster may make a Static Mental test vs an object on the ground to strike it with the earth and cause it to crack or otherwise to damage. In general, the amount of damage to inanimate objects touching the ground will be the equivalent of three lethal.
When used against an animate target, the caster may make a Mental vs Physical challenge (the retest is Athletics) to move the earth under their feet, causing their target to gain the Negative Traits Clumsy x2 as long as they are standing on the ground. Generally if the target is standing on the ground or is on the bottom level of a structure, the movement will be enough to affect them even through a floor or road."}, {"Level": 4, "Name": "Move Terra (Intermediate) - 7XP", "Description": "Move Terra allows the caster to affect a smaller amount of earth much quicker than previous powers. The caster may move a number of cubic feet equal to twice his mental traits in one action. This can create a variety of effects including, but not limited to, the following.
1. A pit to be created under someone. A Mental vs. Physical Challenge (retest with Athletics). If the target fails they are dropped to the bottom of the pit taking one bashing (one cubic foot may be used to make spikes, changing the damage to one lethal.
2. Provide a wall or dome that would absorb three lethal/aggravated (or six bashing) before being destroyed."}, {"Level": 5, "Name": "Grasp of Terra (Advanced) - 10XP", "Description": "The thaumaturge is now able to make the very ground around the target reach up and tear at their clothes, legs, and make it difficult to move with any speed. Make Mental vs. Physical challenge against the target. If the Tremere succeeds, then the target loses all ties in Dexterity related challenges for the remainder of the scene and may only move one step per action."}]

rows.Description: Created by Lord of the Fourth Circle C.L.U Vasa, House Hephaestus, as an aid in business and political dealings. Aims to give the caster an advantage by manipulating the mind and body of the target to mimic certain afflictions at inopportune times. No levels are stackable with another level of this path. This is a House Specific path.
rows.Levels: [{"Level": 1, "Name": "Gentle Words", "Description": "Spend one Blood and test vs 7 mental traits. On success, gain any combination of 2 Charisma-related traits (Charismatic, Charming, Dignified, Eloquent, Expressive, or Genial) for the rest of the scene or one hour. Primarily useful in social challenges involving arguments, politics, or persuasion."}, {"Level": 2, "Name": "Bad Form", "Description": "Spend a Blood and initiate a mental vs mental challenge against your target. If you win against a mortal, the target suffers the negative traits Oblivious and Clumsy. Kindred are affected as if they drank from an intoxicated mortal but the caster must also expend a temporary willpower."}, {"Level": 3, "Name": "Babbling Brook", "Description": "Spend a Blood and engage target in a mental test. On a win, the target gains the negative traits Forgetful and Ignorant for the rest of the night (Kindred require an additional temporary willpower). The target cannot maintain a solid train of thought or finish sentences, though they remember what they wanted to say."}, {"Level": 4, "Name": "Simpleton", "Description": "Spend a temporary Willpower and a Blood, then engage the target in a Willpower challenge. If successful, any time the target takes any action they must first win a static challenge against their own traits (appropriate category), retested with appropriate abilities. Lasts the rest of the night."}, {"Level": 5, "Name": "Bring Forth the Inner Child", "Description": "Requires a trait of the target's blood. Expend a permanent Willpower and a Blood, then engage in a mental challenge followed by an extended challenge (retest Psychology). Successes determine duration: 1=rest of evening, 2=one day, 3=one week, 4=one month, 5=one year, 6=permanent. Changes the target's Nature to Child."}]

rows.Description: This Path is a tantric expression of creation-as-worship. Followers seek to channel the primordial tattvas (elements) into physical forms, forging relics and items that can mirror the power of rare mystical materials.
rows.Levels:
[{"Level": 1, "Name": "Touch of the Tattvas", "Description": "The sorcerer gains the ability to perceive the elemental resonance and mystical potential within materials and objects. This is essential for choosing the right base items for imbuement.
System: Spend 1 Mental Trait and make a Static Mental Challenge (difficulty 6). On success, the user may:
Identify any enchantments on the object.
Detect the dominant elemental alignment of an object or place.
Recognize magical materials or items (including counterfeits or illusions).
Duration: 1 scene"}, {"Level": 2, "Name": "Binding the Flame", "Description": "The vampire can now bind elemental spirits or conceptual forces into items to create powerful relics. These items may act as magical foci, weapons, or protective charms with distinct effects.

System: Spend 2 Willpower, 3 Blood. An item created with this level of this path is considered to have a +2 to the item's Craft rating."}, {"Level": 3, "Name": "Elemental Imprint", "Description": "The caster may infuse a crafted item with elemental energy, choosing from one of the five tattvas: Earth (Prithvi), Water (Apas), Fire (Tejas), Air (Vayu), or Aether (Akasha).
System: Spend 1 Willpower and perform a 10-minute ritual with a Static Mental Challenge (difficulty 7). On success: The object grants one of the following Traits or abilities (choose one) to any character carrying the object with the expenditure of a Mental Trait:
Earth: Gains the Trait Resilient and the item becomes ard to break or damage, winning ties against attempts to do so.
Fire: Adds +1 bonus Trait on Physical Challenges when using the item as a weapon and may spend a point of Willpower to cause an attack to deal aggravated damage.
Water: Grants the bearer +1 trait to resist frenzy or mind control.
Air: Grants +1 step and the *Speed* trait to the item if it is a weapon.
Aether: Allows the bearer to see Spirits for the remainder of the scene."}, {"Level": 4, "Name": "Crucible Emulation", "Description": "At this level, the vampire can "mimic legendary materials" using mundane objects as base matter, transmuted through the sacred crucible of the Sadhana. These emulated materials behave similarly to soulsteel, jade, obsidian, etc.
System: Spend 1 Willpower, 3 Blood, and perform a 30-minute ritual. Then engage in a Static Mental Challenge (difficulty 8) and requires use of samples taken of the intended material.
Transmuted weapons gain one of the following effects:
Soulsteel: The weapon gains Mass Trauma and deals an extra 2 levels of Corpus damage to denizens of the Underworld. Is treated as inert black steel while in the Skinlands.
Jade: The weapon gains Shield Breaking and the bearer +2 bonus traits to resist mind control or supernatural sources of fear.
Silver: The weapon gains the Speed trait and grants +2 Initiative.
Other materials can be used at Storyteller's discretion but should provide only limited benefits."}, {"Level": 5, "Name": "The Divine Artifice", "Description": "Weapons imbued with this power are obviously magical in nature, even to the mundane eye, unless explicitly designed not to be. The process of creating them is taxing and costly to the creator, requiring the use of magical materials, such as Jade and Soulsteel, as well as starlit steel. Only weapons considered masterworks can be so imbued - the spirits being awakened will not tolerate lesser works.

System: Spend 3 Willpower and 2 blood per foot of the weapon being imbued, as well as a sample of an appropriate magical material for the weapon's intended purpose, and make a Static Mental Challenge (difficulty 15).

The awakened spirits of these creations are intelligent and loyal to the individual the weapon was created for - they may communicate with the spirit as if utilising Wooden Tongues or Astral Cant. Each of these weapons is exceptionally sturdy, winning ties against breaking.
Additionally, the creator may permanently imprint a single level of a non-R&U Discipline, or an R2 Blood Magic power that is not paradigm exclusive. This grants that power to the weapon, though in the case of something that has a cost or requires a challenge, that would be paid by the wielder. After the power is utilised 4 times, the weapon must be recharged in a specifically dedicated temple for one lunar month.

There may be no more of these items in existence at one time than the creator's permanent Willpower, and they will only work for the individual they were created for."}]

rows.Description:
This path of Dur-An-Ki was discovered by the more humane and pacifistic among the ashipu. Looking for an alternative to harming another or a path related to war; the Path of the Shepherd was discovered as an alternative. This path focuses on reinforcing calm, peace and deterrents to violence and harm. This path of Dur-An-Ki uses occult for retests. Additionally, the user of this path and those defending against it gain a number of bonus traits to cast and resist its effects equal to their Humanity (not Morality) rating in all challenges.

Cross-reference: See also 'Path of the Shepherd' (also in OWBN Custom Paths), which may represent an alternate version or submission of this Assamite Sorcery path. Both entries are preserved for completeness.
rows.Levels:
[{"Level": 1, "Name": "Peace", "Description": "As humane pacifists the first thing an ashipu learns to master is the ability to maintain the peace and tranquility. Once cast this power allows them an aura of authority and capability to maintain the peace at all time.

System: The vampire spends one blood trait and gains one free retest in all Social Challenges related to negations, peace, leadership or things related to ending a conflict. This retest lasts a scene or an hour."}, {"Level": 2, "Name": "Tranquility", "Description": "To shepherd others to peace one must find peace within themselves. With this power the ashipu focuses and calms themselves taming their beast for a time to better help protect others and not risk falling to frenzy themselves.

System: The caster spends 1 blood trait and may grant the target or themselves two bonus traits for the next scene or an hour to resist all forms of frenzy."}, {"Level": 3, "Name": "Shatter the Mind", "Description": "An ashipu with this level of mastery has learned to stop someone acting in a violent manner by quickly reaching into their mind and making them forget the very reason that triggered the violent outburst in the first place. The person becomes instantly confused and lost unable to recall recent events or even the people who is around and how he got there.

System: The vampire engages their target in a contested mental challenge retested with occult. This may only be used on a victim who is engaged in a violent act of some form or with hostile intentions. If successful the target immediately forgets what they we were doing, why they were doing and even who the caster is. They will be unable to recall why they were about to take their violent action and will generally wander off confused having a hard time remembering anything. This effect will last for a scene or an hour. It will also immediately end if they are attacked. Those under these effects cannot attack the caster or commit violence of any kind."}, {"Level": 4, "Name": "Revoke the Malice", "Description": "Many ashipu possess other powers and abilities to curse or cripple their targets. However these effects often have a set time they last and cannot be ended early. An ashpiu with this power can end any harmful effect they have done to another at any time they wish rather than having to wait until those effects expire.

System: By spending one blood trait the vampire may immediately end any negative effect, curse, or power they have applied to another. This power allows for those effects to end early compared to their normal time limits as presented. Examples include, the Path of Curses, Quell the Beast, or any other negative effect they have already applied to another character. This power has no effect on negative effects done to the caster or those a victim suffers from afflicted by another."}, {"Level": 5, "Name": "Serenity", "Description": "With the final mastery of the path of the Shepherd an ashpiu as has developed the ability to end all conflict in an instant. Once cast those around the ashipu find themselves unable to even consider taking a violent action. To do so they would have to overcome the very will of the ashipu to have any hope to break the serenity he has cast over a room.

System: The vampire spends 1 willpower in addition to the normal blood trait cost to activate this power. For the next scene or hour no violence or combat may occur in the presence of the vampire (limited to the size of one room) unless they defeat the character in a contested willpower challenge. This power ends immediately is the caster takes a violent action himself."}]

rows.Description: A path of Voudoun Necromancy channeling the cold of death and the grave.
rows.Levels:
[{"Level": 1, "Name": "Talons of the Reaper", "Description": "The frigid touch of death comes swift to those who find themselves beneath the Reaper's Talons.

System: The Wangatuer channels the chill of the grave to coat his hands in frigid air that creates a layer of razor edged ice on them up to the elbow. For the scene the Wangatuer's brawling attacks gain the bonus Physical trait Sharp and deal an additional point of damage."}, {"Level": 2, "Name": "Gaze of the End", "Description": "The eyes of Death freeze the blood in the veins of those who oppose him, now your gaze does the same.

System: The Wangatuer can freeze up to a gallon of liquid with a glance upon activating this power. When used on a person this power requires a mental challenge against the target's Physical traits (retest Occult). Upon success this power freezes the liquids inside the body dealing one level of lethal damage (Aggravated Damage to mortals) and destroying a point of blood from their system."}, {"Level": 3, "Name": "Touch of the Winter", "Description": "All things must end and accepting that end is how one brings about new beginnings.

System: The Wangatuer's touch instills death, draining the warmth from a mortal and ultimately ending their life. If the user of this power can keep physical contact with a mortal for three rounds they die as their internal body temperature descends below a point that can sustain life. When used on a non-living target or an inanimate object the surface of the target is first covered in a thin layer of frost and over the course of multiple turns can be frozen solid. The time this takes is determined by the Storyteller.

To an unwilling target this is agonizingly painful, but to those who are ready to depart the cold puts them into a deep sleep where they pass peacefully, the only signs of the users interference being the bluish hue left on their lips by the dropping temperature."}, {"Level": 4, "Name": "Mantle of Death", "Description": "The cloak of death weighs heavy on your shoulders, both a shield and a mighty burden one must carry.

System: By expending a blood and a variable number of mental traits (maximum 5) the target of this power (usually the Wangatuer) is granted an armor-like carapace of ice over their flesh, this grants a number of additional 'Healthy' Health Levels equal to the mental traits spent during the casting. These additional health levels remain for a scene/hour or until they are used."}, {"Level": 5, "Name": "Denial of Life's Spark", "Description": "The truest form of control over the cold of death is the power to deny life's very warmth.

System: When activated by expending a blood and willpower trait the caster cloaks themselves in a vortex of numbing cold that saps the very heat from the air to the point even kinetic energy slows. Within twenty feet of the caster all liquids freeze and frost covers every surface, this effect lasts one round, but the Caster may expend an additional blood trait at the top of each round to sustain the effect without using an action. Those unfortunate enough to find themselves within the effect are sapped of their strength and must make a simple challenge for each physical action they take, including movement. Failure costs them a physical trait and means that the action fails. Should an affected creature drop to zero physical traits within the effect they are subject to one of the following based on creature type:

Non-Living Supernatural: Frozen solid and treated as staked until somehow thawed.
Living Supernatural and Demi-Supernatural: Frozen solid resulting in immediate death.
Non-supernatural creatures within the area of the effect are treated as if under the effect of Touch of Winter, if they cannot escape the effect within three rounds they are frozen solid and die immediately."}]

rows.Description: The Path of the Graveborn taps into necromantic energies surrounding the processes of death and decay. Practitioners recognize that the vampiric form is a walking corpse and draw from Necromancy to augment the user in a variety of ways. Unlike the Bone Path which focuses on zombies, practitioners focus on synthesis with death itself.
rows.Levels: [{"Level": 1, "Name": "Lord of the Flies", "Description": "Spend 1 Blood and an action to summon carrion insects that envelop you until the end of the next turn, granting +2 trait defense against line of sight attacks or powers. You may still make ranged attacks normally. When the power expires, the insects withdraw and heal you for 1 point of lethal damage."}, {"Level": 2, "Name": "Death's Scythe", "Description": "Spend a Blood and a simple action to summon an ethereal scythe. Successful Melee attacks deal base 1 aggravated damage and convert additional Potence damage to aggravated. The weapon possesses traits Deadly and Brutal; if you lose a challenge when bidding these the Scythe shatters. Lasts one scene or hour."}, {"Level": 3, "Name": "Reaper's Due", "Description": "Spend one Willpower and concentrate on your target. Whenever they spend or lose a point of Willpower in your presence you gain +1 bonus in offensive challenges against them (up to 5). Additionally, the target cannot break line of sight for the duration within 50 feet."}, {"Level": 4, "Name": "Knitted Flesh", "Description": "Spend a Blood to activate for 10 minutes. Whenever you spend a point of Willpower to retest a challenge, immediately heal health levels: either 3 lethal or 1 aggravated per activation. Powers that stop the Necromancer from spending Willpower stop this power; permanent Willpower expenditure from another discipline engages the healing effect."}, {"Level": 5, "Name": "Death Perfected", "Description": "Spend 1 Willpower and an action to channel necromantic energies throughout your body. In this form you may add 1/2 your permanent Physical attributes (rounded down) to your Mental or Social attribute when defending against Mental or Social challenges."}]

rows.Description:
While the Giovanni have mastery over the dead, the power of the Maelstrom is beyond their direct control. Through subtle manipulation of the Shroud, some measure of control can be obtained.

Cross-reference: See also 'Path of Maelstrom Manipulation' (also in OWBN Custom Paths), which is the full Archivist entry for Maelstrom-related Necromancy. Both entries are preserved for completeness.
rows.Levels: [{"Level": 1, "Name": "Sense the Tumult", "Description": "Through a static mental test, detect an approaching Maelstrom within a mile per Maelstrom rating, determining its strength and direction of travel. Usable from the Skinlands or Shadowlands. Also allows you to blind a Maelstrom to your presence with a mental test (difficulty 13 + storm rating), protecting nearby allies for a mental trait each. Protection lasts until end of night; specters in the Maelstrom are down two traits to affect protected individuals."}, {"Level": 2, "Name": "Ride the Tempest", "Description": "The Necromancer can blind a Maelstrom to their presence, bulwarking the strength of the Shroud to gain protection from a Maelstrom's damaging effects. Extend this protection to nearby allies for a mental trait each. Lasts until the end of the night."}, {"Level": 3, "Name": "Sigil of the Storm", "Description": "Through mental exertion, mark a person, place, or object with handprint vitae (requires a physical challenge against an unwilling target). Even if the blood is removed, the subject is affected by any Maelstrom they would be in as though they were in the Shadowlands reflection of their current location. Lasts the rest of the night."}, {"Level": 4, "Name": "Command the Cyclone", "Description": "Spend a willpower and make a mental challenge (difficulty 15 + storm rating). Change the direction of the storm up to 45 degrees. This change lasts until the end of the scene or until the storm changes back by its erratic nature or the will of specters within it."}, {"Level": 5, "Name": "Birth the Maelstrom", "Description": "Spend three blood traits and a mental trait to imitate the power of a level one Maelstrom by twisting the Shroud. Creates winds and damage similar to a level one storm without creating actual Maelstroms for wraiths and specters \u2014 just an area of stinging and damaging winds. May be used in conjunction with Sigil of the Storm."}]

rows.Description:
Wangateurs utilize different methods to appease the Orisha to bestow blessings or curses. All levels require the expenditure of blood; levels 4 and 5 additionally require spending a Willpower. The caster must be in the target's presence to initially affect them.

Cross-reference: See also 'Path of Orisha' (also in OWBN Custom Paths), which is the full Archivist entry for this Voudoun Wanga path. Both entries are preserved for completeness.
rows.Levels: [{"Level": 1, "Name": "Bastion of the Orisha", "Description": "While spilling blood onto the ground and reciting a prayer, upon success the blood dissipates. Grants a retest for any self-control/instinct test for any type of frenzy for the remainder of the night. Cannot be stacked. Static Social Challenge vs 10 traits."}, {"Level": 2, "Name": "Temptation of the Orisha", "Description": "While spilling blood onto the ground and reciting a prayer, upon success the blood dissipates. The target is down 1 for any self-control/instinct test for any type of frenzy for the remainder of the night. Cannot be stacked. Contested Social vs Mental Challenge."}, {"Level": 3, "Name": "Pillar of the Orisha", "Description": "While spilling blood onto the ground and reciting a prayer, upon success grant yourself or others a retest for a specified discipline or specific path of magic for the remainder of the night. Cannot be stacked with other applications of this level. Static Social Challenge vs 10 traits."}, {"Level": 4, "Name": "Blessing of the Orisha", "Description": "Spend blood and a Willpower. Increase yourself or your target's selected trait category (Physical/Social/Mental) by up to 5 traits spread as chosen until the next dawn. Does not exceed generational max. While active, the caster is permanently down one blood trait which cannot be replaced until the blessing is released. Static Social Challenge vs 10 traits."}, {"Level": 5, "Name": "Curse of the Orisha", "Description": "Spend blood and a Willpower. Decrease the target's selected trait category (Physical/Social/Mental) by up to 3 traits spread as chosen until the next dawn. While active, the caster is permanently down one blood trait which cannot be replaced until the curse is released. Contested Social vs Mental Challenge."}]

rows.Description: A Voudoun Wanga path channeling the chill and power of death itself through the Wangateur.
rows.Levels: [{"Level": 1, "Name": "Talons of the Reaper", "Description": "The Wangateur channels the chill of the grave to coat their hands in frigid air creating razor-edged ice up to the elbow. For the scene, the Wangateur's brawling attacks gain the bonus Physical trait Sharp and deal an additional point of damage."}, {"Level": 2, "Name": "Gaze of the End", "Description": "The Wangateur can freeze up to a gallon of liquid with a glance. When used on a person, make a mental challenge against the target's Physical traits (retest Occult). On success, freeze liquids inside the body dealing one level of lethal damage (aggravated to mortals) and destroying one blood point."}, {"Level": 3, "Name": "Touch of the Winter", "Description": "The Wangateur's touch instills death, draining warmth. If physical contact is maintained with a mortal for three rounds they die as internal temperature drops below sustainable levels. Against inanimate objects, surfaces are covered in frost and can be frozen solid over multiple turns (Storyteller determines time)."}, {"Level": 4, "Name": "Mantle of Death", "Description": "Spend a blood and a variable number of mental traits (maximum 5). The target (usually the Wangateur) is granted an armor-like carapace of ice, gaining additional Healthy health levels equal to the mental traits spent. These health levels remain for a scene/hour or until used."}, {"Level": 5, "Name": "Denial of Life's Spark", "Description": "Spend a blood and willpower trait. A vortex of numbing cold emanates within twenty feet for one round (spend additional blood at start of each round to sustain). All liquids freeze and frost covers every surface. Those within must make a simple challenge for each physical action; failure costs a physical trait and the action fails. At zero physical traits: Non-living supernaturals are frozen solid (staked). Living supernaturals and demi-supernaturals die. Non-supernatural creatures die if they cannot escape within three rounds."}]

rows.Description:
Discovered by pacifist ashipu as an alternative to paths related to war, focused on reinforcing calm, peace, and deterrents to violence. Uses Occult for retests. The user and those defending against it gain bonus traits equal to their Humanity (not Morality) rating in all challenges.

Cross-reference: See also 'Path of the Enlightened Shepherd' (also in OWBN Custom Paths), which is the full Archivist entry for this pacifist Dur-An-Ki path. Both entries are preserved for completeness.
rows.Levels: [{"Level": 1, "Name": "Pastoral Calm", "Description": "Spend one blood. Gain one free retest in all Social Challenges related to negotiations, peace, leadership, or ending conflict. Lasts a scene or an hour."}, {"Level": 2, "Name": "Inner Peace", "Description": "Spend 1 blood to grant the target or yourself two bonus traits for the next scene or hour to resist all forms of frenzy."}, {"Level": 3, "Name": "Shatter the Mind", "Description": "Engage the target in a contested mental challenge (retest Occult). May only be used on a victim engaged in a violent act or with hostile intentions. If successful, the target immediately forgets what they were doing, why, and even who the caster is. They cannot recall why they were about to act violently and will generally wander off confused. Effect lasts a scene or hour and ends immediately if they are attacked."}, {"Level": 4, "Name": "Revoke the Malice", "Description": "Spend one blood. Immediately end any negative effect, curse, or power you have applied to another character, allowing those effects to end early. Has no effect on negative effects done to the caster or those a victim suffers from another character."}, {"Level": 5, "Name": "Serenity", "Description": "Spend 1 willpower in addition to normal blood cost. For the next scene or hour, no violence or combat may occur in the presence of the vampire (limited to one room) unless they defeat the character in a contested willpower challenge. This power ends immediately if the caster takes a violent action."}]

rows.Description: Where Spirit Manipulation and the Velvet Shadow form a trinity of Dur-An-Ki mastery over the spiritual, the Path of the Velvet Shadow focuses on physically mastering access to the High Umbra where the various Heavens of the world exist. Requires mastery of Spirit Manipulation.
rows.Levels: [{"Level": 1, "Name": "Eye of Heaven", "Description": "Spend 1 willpower. For the next scene or an hour, the ashipu knows the exact realm of the Umbra they may be in. Useful for any who travel the cosmos and may become lost."}, {"Level": 2, "Name": "Guidance of the Stars", "Description": "Spend 1 willpower. For the next scene or hour, the ashipu can sense direction in the Umbra and find a location or person within the spirit world. As long as they follow the sense created by this power, the caster will not become lost in the Velvet Shadow."}, {"Level": 3, "Name": "Return From the Stars", "Description": "When in any area of the Umbra, spend 1 willpower and make a static Willpower challenge against the difficulty of the Gauntlet to cross back over. Success returns the ashipu to the normal world."}, {"Level": 4, "Name": "Door to the Heavens", "Description": "Draw a doorway in blood and spend 1 willpower to create a doorway to the High Umbra. Only the caster may use this doorway. The vampire faces many dangers in the High Umbra (no blood, hostile spirits, Lupines). Anytime the ashipu wishes to return, spend 1 willpower to return to earth."}, {"Level": 5, "Name": "Gauntlet Mastery", "Description": "Spend 1 willpower plus temporary Mental traits to lower or raise the Gauntlet rating by one level per Mental Trait spent. Raising the Gauntlet to 10 makes it extremely difficult for creatures to cross from the Umbra. Lowering it to 1 makes crossing incredibly easy (possibly for those who cannot normally cross). The alteration lasts one scene or hour."}]

rows.Description: Created by Regent Premysl, this path uses the energies of pride, conceit, and vanity to bolster appearance. Each use imparts the negative trait Condescending for the night, which stacks with repeated uses. Uses Occult for retests.
rows.Levels: [{"Level": 1, "Name": "Convalescent Composure", "Description": "Spend 1 blood. Instantly clean and groom appearance: clothes cleaned and ironed, hair combed and trimmed, face groomed as desired including makeup. Cannot grow hair, change eye color, or perform significant physical modifications. Reverts to natural state at dawn."}, {"Level": 2, "Name": "Fountain of Youth", "Description": "Spend 1 blood. Create a prismatic light show that funnels into the caster's mouth. Instantly replenish all traits in the Appearance-related category (Gorgeous, Elegant, Seductive, Alluring, Dignified, etc.). Takes effect at the end of the round it is cast. May only be used once per night."}, {"Level": 3, "Name": "Glamour Siphon", "Description": "Engage the victim in a social challenge. If successful, steal 2 appearance-related social traits (caster's choice) from the victim, gaining them as temporary traits (can exceed generational maximum) for the scene. The victim loses those traits for the night. May only reap benefits once per scene but may inflict trait loss on multiple victims. Once used on a victim, they are immune to further uses from the same thaumaturge for the rest of the night."}, {"Level": 4, "Name": "Premysl's Pleasing Pulchritude", "Description": "Spend 1 blood. Gain the traits Gorgeous and Elegant until end of scene, hour, or when spent/lost. While holding these traits, may call for one retest in a single failed Social Challenge (in addition to any other retests). May only be used once per scene. Traits gained can be stacked with Glamour Siphon and may exceed generational maximum."}, {"Level": 5, "Name": "Airs of Aphrodite", "Description": "Spend a temporary Willpower. Take an extra action during your turn so long as that action is Social in nature. While this power is active, if the thaumaturge uses the Presence discipline, powers that allow the victim to win ties (Iron Heart, Perfect Clarity, etc.) are ineffective. Lasts for one scene or 10 minutes. May be activated concurrently with Dual Thought but the caster must choose between the two extra actions each round."}]

rows.Description: Ascending the Ladder of Heaven the ashipu travels to the farthest reaches of the heavens and seeks covenants with Pluto. This path reflects that covenant and grants the Ashipu mastery over the forces of Winter.
rows.Levels: [{"Level": 1, "Name": "Frost Bite", "Description": "Fire a shard of ice at a target with a mental versus physical challenge; success deals one level of bashing damage and inflicts the negative trait Clumsy for the remainder of the scene. Additionally, freeze any liquid in your presence up to the size of your body (takes several minutes)."}, {"Level": 2, "Name": "Snowfall", "Description": "Spend 1 willpower (plus possible additional willpower based on outside conditions). Make it snow in an area of one room or larger (+1 willpower per additional room). Those in the blizzard must bid four additional traits on sight checks (Auspex users only 2 extra), and suffer the negative trait Clumsy from slippery conditions. Lasts one scene or an hour; only usable outdoors."}, {"Level": 3, "Name": "Icy Chill of Despair", "Description": "Engage the target in a mental versus physical challenge. If successful, spend up to 5 temporary mental traits to immediately freeze a corresponding number of blood traits in the victim. Each frozen trait is unusable for one hour or a scene. Mortals affected are instantly killed."}, {"Level": 4, "Name": "Frost Blades", "Description": "Spend a number of mental traits to summon a corresponding number of frost blades (maximum 5) that float around the caster telekinetically. For attack: make a mental versus physical challenge; success deals 1 lethal per blade and inflicts Clumsy for the scene (each blade requires a separate challenge). For defense: each blade provides one health level of armor. Once used (attacking or defending) the blade is consumed."}, {"Level": 5, "Name": "The Mask of Winters", "Description": "Spend three blood and one willpower to assume the Avatar of Winter form for the remainder of a scene or an hour. Gain: +2 bonus on all virtue challenges; unarmed strikes sap 1 willpower from targets per strike; immunity to all cold or chilling effects. The ashipu's hair turns white, eyes become unnatural blue, and cracks of frost form in their skin."}]

rows.Description:
Practitioners of Yamaloka Sadhana do not dominate the dead, nor do they summon them as tools—they walk the space between, where karma stagnates and Oblivion festers. Their role is that of psychopomp, karmic purifier, and warrior ascetic who resists the pull of Oblivion, not with brute force, but with spiritual order.

Unlike Necromancers, Yamaloka Sadhus do not manipulate ghosts like currency. They guide, banish, or confront them when corrupted, often through self-purifying suffering or symbolic reenactments of karmic debt.
rows.Levels:
[{"Level": 1, "Name": "Echo Recognition", "Description": "By entering a brief trance and reciting a mantra of remembrance, the Sadhu can detect spiritual residue left by the dead. This does not pierce the Shroud or expose ghosts directly—instead, it reveals memories of trauma or karmic stains left behind by spirits or Specters.

System: The character makes a Static Mental Challenge retested with Occult against a difficulty of 8. If they succeed, the character can sense that a location or person was recently touched by death or corrupted, revealing itself in the form of flashes of insight pertaining to the moments that caused the corruption or death. A murder weapon, last words gurgled out by a victim are all common. Supernatural events perpetrated by a corrupted werewolf might be symbolized with the sounds of yipping and a green moon. What is seen is ultimately up to the storyteller."}, {"Level": 2, "Name": "Flesh-to-Ash", "Description": "Through rigorous fasting, ascetic postures, and mantras, the Sadhu transforms themselves into a symbol of death incarnate. For the duration of this power, they radiate a repellent aura to the dead, not through fear—but through non-attachment.

System: Once activated and for the next scene or an hour, any Specter or Oblivion tainted creature must spend 1 temporary Willpower trait and make a Willpower challenge with difficulty equal to their own Being to approach the Sadhu in any way for the scene. Even if they succeed, any Specter who enters loses one point of Angst each turn."}, {"Level": 3, "Name": "Burden of the Black Thread", "Description": "The Sadhu may bind a Specter or corrupted soul to its unresolved karmic burden, forcing it to relive symbolic moments of its past misdeeds. This stuns the entity into a metaphysical confrontation with its own actions.

System: The character makes a contested Mental Challenge retested with Occult against a Specter or Oblivion related creature. If they succeed the target suffers 1 level of unsoakable bashing damage per turn for 3 turns as it symbolically burns in the fire of unresolved karma. Additionally the target must make a Static Willpower Challenge at difficulty 8 during this time, should they fail, their Psyche rises to the surface. Should the creature not possess a Psyche, it is unable to act for that turn."}, {"Level": 4, "Name": "Lotus of Inversion", "Description": "The Sadhu performs a complex mudra-meditation and creates a ritual field in which all death-aspected energies are inverted—hate becomes sorrow, despair becomes longing, violence becomes mourning. This field distorts the metaphysical link Specters have to Oblivion.

System: The character makes a contested Mental Challenge retested with Occult against any specter or oblivion tainted creature that comes within ten feet of them for the next scene or an hour. If the target fails the challenge, they lose one Shadow Based power they may possess named by the caster for the next scene or an hour and may not spend Angst for one turn."}, {"Level": 5, "Name": "Cycle Severance Invocation", "Description": "This ultimate act cuts a soul's tie to the cycle—either severing its karmic anchor and sending it onward (to Lethe or beyond), or flinging a Specter into the void of non-rebirth. The Sadhu essentially forcibly reincarnates or casts out the entity.

System: The character engaged the target Specter or Oblivion related creature in a contested Mental Challenge retested with occult. If they succeed The entity is banished from the area for one night. If the character spends a second willpower when casting this power and succeed the creature is discarnated—unable to manifest for 3 nights. Finally, if the caster spends a third willpower at the time of using this power, they may make a second challenge. If successful, the entity is drawn into dissolution: a place beyond the Tempest (or Lethe for non-corrupted souls). For Specters, this is a spiritual unmaking unless saved by some external force. All that remains in their place is a statue of white jade."}]

rows.Description: A Hermetic Thaumaturgy path focused on the manipulation of gravitational forces.
rows.Levels:
[{"Level": 1, "Name": "Gravitic Redistribution", "Description": "Spend 1 Blood and choose a number of Melee Weapons you can see equal to your levels in the Occult Ability. For each of those weapons, you may either add the Negative Trait: Heavy for the remainder of the scene or remove the Negative Trait: Heavy for the scene. A single weapon can only be affected by one instance of Gravitic Redistribution at a time. Furthermore, if you activate this ability more than once in a scene, the weapons targeted are affected instead of those previously targeted rather than in addition to them."}, {"Level": 2, "Name": "Microsingularity", "Description": "Spend 1 Blood. For a number of rounds equal to your levels in the Occult Ability, you are surrounded by potent gravitational anomalies that render ranged attacks much less effective against them. You and all subjects - friend or foe - within 10 feet of you gain a free retest against all physical ranged attacks targeting them. Those inside the area of effect suffer no penalty when shooting targets outside of it. A character protected by this power can only use one such retest per attack, regardless of how many Thaumaturges are using this power in close proximity to one another."}, {"Level": 3, "Name": "Crushing Force", "Description": "Spend 1 blood and make a Mental Challenge (retest Occult) against a target's Physical Traits, which can be retested with Athletics. If successful, the target gains the Negative Physical Trait 'Clumsy' for as long as this power is maintained.

Each round you may spend an action to maintain the effect at no additional Blood Cost. Each round you do so, you may attempt another Mental Challenge as detailed above. If successful, the target gains an additional 'Clumsy', but if you fail the power automatically breaks. No more than five 'Clumsy' traits can be applied by this power. A single target may only be affected by one instance of Crushing Force at a time, and you can only affect one target with Crushing Force at a time. If you do not spend an action to maintain the effect in a round, the effect stops at the end of that round."}, {"Level": 4, "Name": "Hypergravity Field", "Description": "Spend 1 blood. For the rest of the scene, you may invoke one of the following two effects:

1 - The movement speed of all subjects other than you within 30 feet of you is cut in half, rounded up.
2 - Subjects other than you are unable to fly by any means within 30 feet of you.

You may dismiss this effect reflexively at any time. If you wish to change from one effect to another, this requires a separate activation. You cannot activate this power twice and maintain both effects at once. Furthermore, multiple instances of this power intersecting are not cumulative, and the effect chosen defaults to the most recently activated instance of this power."}, {"Level": 5, "Name": "Event Horizon", "Description": "By spending 2 Blood and 1 Willpower, the Thaumaturge makes a small, immobile Black Hole anywhere within line of sight. For the rest of the scene, or until you dismiss the power, everything other than you within 30 feet of the Black Hole is dragged towards it with incredible force, moving 3 steps (9 feet) towards it at the end of each round of combat, after celerity actions.

Anyone touching the Black Hole at the end of the Thaumaturge's turn automatically takes 2 levels of Lethal damage that cannot be reduced or altered by any means, including (but not limited to) the Fortitude Power Resistance, the Visceratika power Armor of Terra, and items that reduce incoming damage taken. This damage can only be negated by powers such as Aegis that nullify the effects of an attack in its entirety.

The damage caused by Event Horizon is widespread and indiscriminate, affecting everything within its area of effect from small objects to vehicles to buildings. The environmental damage of this power is up to the storyteller, though the structural damage to buildings should be roughly equivalent to that caused by a mid-level earthquake.

You can only use Event Horizon to summon one Black Hole at a time. Furthermore, if the effect radius of Event Horizon touches the effect radius of another instance of this power, both Black Holes immediately collapse."}]

rows.Description:
Rego Magia Legis functions greatly on objective truth rather than subjective perception. An ST should be present for all uses to adjudicate objective In Character Guilt and Reality.

Cross-reference: See also 'Rego Magia Legis (Path of Law Magic)' (also in OWBN Custom Paths), which is the full Archivist entry for this path. Both entries are preserved for completeness.
rows.Levels: [{"Level": 1, "Name": "Malum In Se (Evil In Itself)", "Description": "Make a Mental Challenge against the target (retest Law). If successful, sense how many times the target has committed an act of objective evil (murder, theft, assault, etc.) within a number of days equal to your permanent Willpower. You learn when actions were committed, not what was done."}, {"Level": 2, "Name": "Malum Prohibitum (Forbidden Evil)", "Description": "Functions identically to Malum In Se but focused on a specific, pre-established legal or ethical code (US Federal Law, The Traditions of the Camarilla, etc.). Sense how many times the code has been violated within your Willpower in days."}, {"Level": 3, "Name": "Compos Mentis (Of Composed Mind)", "Description": "After 10 minutes of meditative focus, spend one blood and specify a specific period (no greater than one hour) in the subject's history. For the next scene or hour, the subject remembers all details of that period with Eidetic Memory. May restore altered (not destroyed) memories with a Static Mental Challenge (retest Law). Difficulty equals mental traits of whoever altered the memories. The Lawmage also learns intuitively whether the subject's actions were of their own free will."}, {"Level": 4, "Name": "In Flagrante Delicto (Caught in the Act)", "Description": "May only be used if the Lawmage personally witnesses the target committing an act detectable by Malum In Se or Malum Prohibitum. Spend 1 blood and make a Mental Challenge against the target (retest Law). If successful, spend 1-3 Mental Traits. The target takes that many levels of aggravated damage and loses that many temporary willpower. Only usable once per scene and must be performed in the same scene the triggering act was committed."}, {"Level": 5, "Name": "Hostes Populi (Enemy of the People)", "Description": "Requires Humanity 5+ (or 3+ on a 1-5 scale). Spend 1 Blood and 1 Willpower, make a Mental Challenge (retest Law), and state a specific serious crime the target committed. If guilty and heinous enough, the target is branded with a mark only Kindred can see that cannot be concealed. All Kindred challenging the branded target gain bonus traits equal to their Humanity. If innocent or the crime was insufficiently heinous, the power fails and the Lawmage loses all current Willpower for the night."}]

rows.Path: Rego Magia Legis (Path of Law Magic)
rows.Description:
NOTE: Rego Magia Legis functions greatly on objective truth rather than subjective perception. As such, it is strongly recommended that an ST be present for all uses of Rego Magia Legis to adjudicate objective In Character Guilt and Reality.

Cross-reference: This is the full Archivist entry for 'Rego Magia Legis' (also in OWBN Custom Paths). The other entry may contain earlier or abbreviated content. Both entries are preserved for completeness.
rows.Levels:
[{"Level": 1, "Name": "Malum In Se (Evil In Itself)", "Description": "Make a Mental Challenge against the target, retest Law. If successful, the Lawmage gains a sense of how many times a user has committed an act of objective evil within a number of days equal to the Lawmage's permanent Willpower. Acts of objective evil include murder, theft, assault, or generally any action that would cause someone with Four Humanity or less (Two on a One-Five scale) to chop for Path Rating loss. The Lawmage does not glean any information on what was done, only that the action was committed, and when. This power is not subtle, usually involving direct interrogation or questioning."}, {"Level": 2, "Name": "Malum Prohibitum (Forbidden Evil)", "Description": "Mechanically, this power functions identically to Malum In Se. However, when used, the Lawmage focuses on a specific, pre-established legal or ethical code (US Federal Law, MN State Law, The Traditions of the Camarilla, and The Code of Milan are all acceptable examples. A PC's individual Code of Honor is not). If successful, the Lawmage gains a sense of how many times a user has broken that legal or ethical code within a number of days equal to the Lawmage's permanent Willpower. The Lawmage does not glean any information on what was done, only that the action was committed, and when. This power is not subtle, usually involving direct interrogation or questioning."}, {"Level": 3, "Name": "Compos Mentis (Of Composed Mind)", "Description": "After 10 minutes of meditative focus with the subject, the Lawmage spends one blood and specifies a specific period of time in the subject's history, no greater than one hour in length. For the next scene or hour, whichever is longer, the subject remembers all details of that time period as though they had the Merit 'Eidetic Memory'. Furthermore, if the subject's memories during that event had been altered in any way, the Lawmage may immediately make a Static Mental Challenge (retest Law) to restore those memories for the power's duration. The difficulty of this challenge should be determined by the mental traits of whoever altered the memories of the subject. This cannot restore memories that were completely destroyed or removed, only altered through The Forgetful Mind or similar effects. If a Dominate power was used to alter the subject's memory, a Generation Check is still required by the Lawmage to recover the memories. Finally, the Lawmage gets an intuitive knowledge of whether the actions taken by the subject during that time block were of their own free will or compelled by another source (though this does not give the Lawmage knowledge of who is responsible for any such compulsion). The Lawmage cannot use this power on themselves, only others. When the power ends, the subject's memory of that time block returns to normal."}, {"Level": 4, "Name": "In Flagrante Delicto (In Flagrant Delinquency)", "Description": "This power can only be used if a Lawmage personally witnesses the target committing an act that would be detected by either the powers Malum In Se or Malum Prohibitum. Upon witnessing said act, the Lawmage may spend 1 blood and make a Mental Challenge against the Target (Retest Law). If successful, the Lawmage may spend 1-3 Mental Traits. The target takes a number of levels of aggravated damage and loses a number of temporary willpower equal to the traits spent. This can only be used against a given target once per scene, and MUST be performed in the same scene that the triggering act was committed."}, {"Level": 5, "Name": "Hostes Populi (The Enemy of The People)", "Description": "This power can only be used by a Lawmage with Five or more Humanity (Or Three or more on a One-Five scale)

Spend 1 Blood and 1 Willpower and make a Mental Challenge against the target, retest Law, and state a specific serious crime that the target has committed. Qualifying acts of extreme evil include any action that would cause a Kindred with Humanity 2 (Or 1 on a One-Five Scale) to make a Humanity Chop. Crimes not listed in the Humanity Hierarchy of sins (such as Treason) may be applicable at ST discretion. Camarilla Citizens found guilty of egregious violations of The Traditions or Tremere found guilty of egregious violations of The Oath are considered valid targets for this power. Though unlikely to ever occur, this could also apply to Members of the Sabbat found guilty of egregious violations of the Code of Milan.

If the target is guilty and the act is sufficiently heinous, they are branded by a mystical mark that labels the target as an Enemy of the People. The brand can only be seen by Kindred, but cannot be concealed by any means. All Kindred who make a challenge of any kind against the branded target gain a number of bonus traits equal to their own Humanity rating (or half rounded up on a One-Ten scale). Kindred on non-Humane paths gain no benefit. While this mark is almost always used as a death sentence, it can be removed by the Lawmage at any time by spending a willpower if they believe the subject of the brand has properly repented for their crime.

If the crime declared was insufficiently specific, this power simply fails. If the target is innocent of the crime, or the crime declared was insufficiently heinous, then not only does the power fail, but the Lawmage loses ALL of their current Willpower and cannot regain it for the rest of the night.

A target cannot be branded for a specific crime more than once in their lives (though if they commit the same crime multiple times, they may be branded for each instance). Multiple brands do not stack with one another."}]

rows.Description:
Mixing Sand with ashes, over a full moon night, the magister creates a golden colored dust then increases the effect of rituals and paths of dreams
Granding an extra retest for the next performance of this kind of ritual and path in the same month.

Dream paths and Ritual
Dreamcatcher
Oneiromancy
Path of Morpheus

System:
1 extra retest per month for 1 specific ritual and 2 specific paths, need to be performed (precast) on a specific night of full moon.
rows.Levels: [{"Level": 1, "Name": "Sandman Sand", "Description": "System: 1 extra retest per month for 1 specific ritual and 2 specific paths, need to be performed (precast) on a specific night of full moon.\n\nDream paths and Ritual affected: Dreamcatcher, Oneiromancy, Path of Morpheus."}]

rows.Description: The scribes and magi of the Banu Haqim are reputedly the oldest of all practicing blood magicians. Masters of this path find their entire repository safe and easily accessible. Practitioners must have the Background: Occult Library to gain the most from this path.
rows.Levels: [{"Level": 1, "Name": "Bind and Unbind", "Description": "Spend one Blood Point and make a Static Mental Challenge vs complexity of the documents (Storyteller's discretion). Success allows documents to be easily separated or re-bound without damage. Intricate or extremely fragile works may require higher difficulty; failure may damage the works."}, {"Level": 2, "Name": "Never a Secret Lost", "Description": "Spend one Blood Point to mystically brand a book in your possession. You thereby know the exact whereabouts of the book at all times (described as a sensation rather than an image). Books marked in this fashion cannot be un-marked. Multiple Sorcerers may imbue their glyph over the years."}, {"Level": 3, "Name": "Arcane Recall", "Description": "Spend a Willpower and a Blood Point. For the rest of the scene, gain additional retests equal to the accumulated points of a specific ability within your tomes. These do not count as ability retests and cannot exceed your rating in this path. The specific ability must be designated beforehand. May only be used once before needing to be re-cast."}, {"Level": 4, "Name": "Locked Away", "Description": "Spend a Willpower and Blood plus temporary mental traits up to your rating in this path. For each Mental trait spent, the Library gains one level of Background: Arcane and Background: Haven for protection purposes. Lasts a number of days equal to the Mental traits spent."}, {"Level": 5, "Name": "The Librarian's Defense", "Description": "Spend three Blood Points and three Willpower Points. For the remainder of the scene, the very words of surrounding tomes spring to life as weapons. The library has traits equal to the caster's Mental Traits + Occult ability, inflicts lethal damage equal to the Occult Library Rating per attack, and makes one additional Physical attack each round against the target. For every 5 levels of damage taken, the Library loses one rating; at 0 rating this power ends."}]

rows.Description: A Hermetic Thaumaturgy path focused on light manipulation.
rows.Levels: [{"Level": 1, "Name": "Brilliance (Basic)", "Description": "Spend a blood and make a mental challenge. If sucessful, the target isstunned for a round. If Heighten Senses sight is up, the target is blind for an hour/scene (whichever comes first)."}, {"Level": 2, "Name": "Luminance (Basic)", "Description": "Spend a blood and make a static mental challenge against the target in line of sight. If sucessful, the target is illuminated by an aura of light around their body. The target is unable to use Obfuscate level 2 or lower and if in Shroud, any attacker against them does not succmb to a Shroud retest. Also, can be used on an object for a light source in the darkness."}, {"Level": 3, "Name": "Radiance (Intermediate)", "Description": "Spend a blood and create a 20 ft sphere of light in any location within 50 ft. All inside, except the caster, is two traits down on any challenge, are clums, and must submit to a blind retest to any succesful challenge as it is too bright to see. If cast while Shroud of Night is active, both are destroyed and if Shroud of Night is used while this power is in affect, they are both nullified."}, {"Level": 4, "Name": "Incandescensce (Intermediate)", "Description": "Spend a blood and make a mental vs physical challenge against your target. If successful, the target is hit with a beam of light that is as hot as the sun. It burn any vampiric target for 3 aggravated damage, if they are susceptible to light (ie tenebrous form, black metamorphosis, light sensitivity flaw) it takes one additional aggravated damage. If it hits any mortal, the damage is converted to bashing."}, {"Level": 5, "Name": "Resplendence (Advanced)", "Description": "Light warps around the caster making them invisible. If the user is invisible they are only detectable by touch. While moving they can be spotted in auspex. The user may add in the levels of this path to compare ties. The user is partially blinded by and is 2 traits down on all vision related challenges."}]

rows.Description: Failures in Spirit Thaumaturgy are not recommended — the spirit of a botched summoning may turn out to be a Specter or may decide to follow and harass the vampire.
rows.Levels: [{"Level": 1, "Name": "Evil Eye", "Description": "Summon a wraith to harass a victim. Defeat the victim in a Mental Challenge. If successful, the victim must bid two extra Traits in any challenges for 10 minutes. Extend the duration at the cost of one Mental Trait per five additional minutes."}, {"Level": 2, "Name": "Spirit Eyes", "Description": "Attempt to see and communicate with wraiths in the area. Make a successful Mental Challenge versus the wraith to see or communicate with it. Communicate for five minutes per Mental Trait expended."}, {"Level": 3, "Name": "Spirit Slave", "Description": "Win a Mental Challenge against a wraith to bind it to remain and answer any questions or perform any one task. An unwilling wraith might perform the task poorly. An additional use can force a recently dead wraith into permanently haunting the present location (subject to Storyteller discretion to wear off)."}, {"Level": 4, "Name": "Sight of the Dead", "Description": "Obtain dirt from a freshly dug grave. Mix in x blood traits while reading backwards from the Bible, then smear the dirt/blood mixture behind your ears and on your eyelids. Allows the caster (or those the ritual is performed on) to see and hear wraiths for x hours, where x is the number of blood traits spent."}]

rows.Description: When humans learned to harness the power of the Djinn from Suleiman himself, the Djinn fled to the High Umbra. Rarely seen in the modern age, they are usually never considered friendly. This path allows the ashipu to detect, identify, capture, and command Djinn.
rows.Levels: [{"Level": 1, "Name": "Kohl Sight", "Description": "Spend a Willpower on top of normal costs and rub charcoal across your closed eyes. When open, you can see into the High Umbra (Astral) for as long as the charcoal remains, allowing line of sight and use of the rest of this path upon Djinn within. Aura Perception may additionally be needed to find purposefully hidden Djinn."}, {"Level": 2, "Name": "Know Thy Name", "Description": "Enter into a contested mental challenge (retest Lore: Djinn). If successful, find a part of the Djinn's True Name. You must be able to see the target (possibly requiring Kohl Sight). Gaining more of the true name requires study and research beyond this power."}, {"Level": 3, "Name": "Prepare Thy Vessel", "Description": "Make a static mental challenge against 9 + the level of Djinn (1-7). Creates a vessel that is fireproof, watertight, and very hard to destroy (health levels = Occult Rating x Crafts Rating x Rank of Djinn). Must be appropriately sized for the Djinn's rank and inscribed with the appropriate seal (ideally including the Djinn's true name)."}, {"Level": 4, "Name": "Bottle of Djinn", "Description": "Open the prepared vessel and say a short phrase; the targeted Djinn is sucked in with no additional challenge. Unless stoppered within the next 3 rounds, the Djinn escapes with no challenge. Also allows you to identify a vessel at a glance (but not what Djinn it was made for without research)."}, {"Level": 5, "Name": "Your Wish is My Command", "Description": "Call upon the sealed Djinn and its power. Functions like Elemental Mastery 5 but requires a captured Djinn in your possession. Make a Static Mental Challenge to command the Djinn; it will follow your direction for the rest of the scene. Effects vary depending on which Djinn you have sealed and what you require of it."}]

rows.Description: The practitioner has become skilled at noticing the intangible links between acausal events, drawing forth knowledge from the subtle interconnectedness of all things, and even forcing the world to adopt new archetypical axioms. This path is both roleplay and creativity heavy.
rows.Levels: [{"Level": 1, "Name": "Archetypical Intraexamination", "Description": "Spend one blood and one mental trait, then make a simple test vs a variable difficulty (ST discretion). On a success, the ST provides an answer to a question posed as a strange coincidence or enigmatic vision. Failure retrieves nonsense; on a failure the ST may request a follow-up test \u2014 a second failure means the information is dangerously misleading. May only be used once per subject per scene or hour."}, {"Level": 2, "Name": "Conjunctive Dowsing", "Description": "Spend one blood, then make a contested mental challenge against the source of the effect being dowsed. On success, trace the sympathetic links between cause and effect \u2014 effectively identifying and locating either the caster or the effect. Does not work on self-contained effects like rituals, effects not actively maintained, or effects the Magus is unaware of."}, {"Level": 3, "Name": "Drafter's Prerogative", "Description": "Spend one blood, then make a contested mental challenge against each target you wish to forge a connection between (targets must be willing or unattended objects). For one hour or the scene, a single type of effect used on one target is halved and shared between the two. A single target cannot be affected by more than one use of this power at once."}, {"Level": 4, "Name": "Praxis of Will", "Description": "Spend one blood, then make a static mental challenge vs a variable difficulty (ST discretion). Success allows the Magus to determine the results of a random event or cause a plausible random event. Multiple uses in the same scene increase the difficulty. Cannot be used in combat."}, {"Level": 5, "Name": "Prophetic Self-Actualization", "Description": "Spend one blood and one Willpower. For the remainder of the scene, you may spend one mental trait and describe an unbelievable coincidence which grants you one additional, Might-like defensive retest."}]

rows.Description:
Developed by a Victorian Ashipu, this Dur-An-Ki path is derived from the lost divination art of Tea Reading. After performing the tea ceremony and reading the pattern of leaves in the cup, the ashipu gains flashes of insight, which can be both a blessing and a curse.

Cross-reference: See also 'The Path of Tasseography' (also in OWBN Custom Paths), which is the same content submitted with the full title prefix. Both entries are preserved for completeness.
rows.Levels: [{"Level": 1, "Name": "The Magician", "Description": "Engage the target in a Mental Challenge (retest Enigmas). If successful, gain one important detail about their life \u2014 traumatic events such as Embrace, Murder, etc. are revealed. Each additional event requires a new challenge and activation. Details always come in the form of clear, precise visions."}, {"Level": 2, "Name": "The High Priestess", "Description": "Engage the target in a Mental Challenge (retest Enigmas). If successful, discern one future event that will occur to the character (presented as visions). Additionally, those affected by this power gain one Fate retest to use in any single challenge for the remainder of the night."}, {"Level": 3, "Name": "The Lovers", "Description": "Make a Static Mental Challenge (difficulty 9, retest Enigmas). Determine the approximate location of a nearby object or person \u2014 this takes the form of a subconscious tug. To locate a specific person, you must either know the subject intimately or have an item closely associated with them."}, {"Level": 4, "Name": "The Wheel of Fortune", "Description": "Travel to the desired location where a past event occurred, then perform the tea leaf reading. Make a Static Mental Challenge (difficulty 9, retest Enigmas). If successful, view an event of the past as if you had actually been there (full sensory experience). You may not interact with the events or use other powers during the scene being viewed."}, {"Level": 5, "Name": "The Devil", "Description": "Engage the target in a contested Mental Challenge (retest Enigmas). If successful, spend 1 permanent Willpower. Choose to either curse the target (giving them the Dark Fate flaw that cannot be bought off until the caster ends the effect) or bless the target (allowing them to purchase the Merit: Destined for Greatness)."}]

rows.Description: Vampiric Eastern Necromancers adapted the techniques of mortal Eastern Necromancers who created the original Terracotta Army. Requires Crafts: Terracotta or Clay (Specialization: Terracotta) and Science: Human Anatomy or Medicine. For willing wraiths spend a vitae and win or tie 2 simple tests. For unwilling wraiths, first win a contested social challenge. All Terracotta soldiers are considered supernatural creatures.
rows.Levels: [{"Level": 1, "Name": "\u00c8rd\u011bng B\u012bng (Private)", "Description": "Imbue a terracotta soldier with a simple, nearly mindless wraith. Can perform simple repetitive tasks (digging, sweeping, carrying) but cannot fight. 6 Physical traits, 0 Social, 3 Mental traits, 5 health levels, no abilities. Cannot employ Arcanoi or Pathos."}, {"Level": 2, "Name": "Xi\u00e0shi (Corporal)", "Description": "Produce soldiers with greater intelligence. Can perform moderately complex tasks requiring some common sense. 9 Physical, 0 Social, 6 Mental traits, 5 health levels, 2 basic non-combat abilities (cannot exceed first dot), 1 basic non-combat Arcanoi."}, {"Level": 3, "Name": "Sh\u00e0ngshi (Sergeant)", "Description": "Produce soldiers with simulated minds capable of handling combat. 12 Physical, 3 Social, 6 Mental traits, 10 health levels, 4 abilities (can be combat-related, max 2 dots each), up to 4 basic Arcanoi (determined by the wraith placed inside, not exceeding basic levels)."}, {"Level": 4, "Name": "Sh\u00e0ngw\u00e8i (Captain)", "Description": "Create formidable soldiers capable of commanding lesser soldiers and performing complex tasks without supervision. 15 Physical, 6 Social, 9 Mental traits, up to 9 abilities (max third dot), 6 basic Arcanoi and up to 2 intermediate Arcanoi."}, {"Level": 5, "Name": "\u00c8rj\u00ed Sh\u00e0ngji\u00e0ng (General)", "Description": "The pinnacle \u2014 the most intricate soldiers that can even fool humans and supernaturals into thinking them alive. They have the personality of the residing wraith and work with the necromancer. 18 Physical, 9 Social, 12 Mental traits, up to 15 abilities (max third dot, 5 abilities can reach fifth dot), full access to the wraith's Arcanoi and Tempers on their sheet."}]

rows.Description: A subtle path of Dark Thaumaturgy. Its use is not betrayed by outward signs, and even supernatural detection must be made as contested challenges against the caster. Based on techniques adapted from demonic patrons.
rows.Levels: [{"Level": 1, "Name": "Record Keeping", "Description": "Spend a Blood Trait and make a Static Mental Challenge. If successful, the caster learns the nature of any pacts, bonds, or spiritual ties (Blood Bonds, covenants, Infernal Bargains, etc.), current or broken, between the target and any other beings."}, {"Level": 2, "Name": "Breach of Contract", "Description": "Whenever an explicit contract is made, spend 1 Willpower Trait to formalize it. The caster is automatically made aware when a formalized contract has been broken or violated, and may make a Static Mental Challenge to ascertain the details."}, {"Level": 3, "Name": "Terms and Conditions", "Description": "Spend 1 Blood Trait and make a Static Mental Challenge against the victim. If successful, learn the details of one of the target's contracts. The caster must be aware of the contract's existence beforehand."}, {"Level": 4, "Name": "Implied Venue", "Description": "Only usable on a target who has engaged in a contract sealed with Breach of Contract. Spend 1 Blood Trait and make a Static Mental Challenge. If successful, gain intuitive knowledge of the contractee's exact location, and optionally engage in a second Mental Challenge to remotely observe them for a scene."}, {"Level": 5, "Name": "Mandatory Injunction", "Description": "Spend 1 Willpower Trait and make a Mental Challenge against the target. Success compels the target to complete the terms of the contract. If a Kindred target cannot fulfill the terms, they succumb to torpor. Non-Kindred suffer 5 unsoakable aggravated damage healed only at 1 per month."}]

rows.Description:
The Path Beyond
This path is designed for walking through the realms often considered out of reach to Cainites. It is a Necromantic interpretation of the Wraith Arcanos "Argos" and serves as a pathway for a daring Necromancer to explore the realms beyond and bear witness to the Far Shores and stranger realms connected. This Path of Eastern Necromancy is Yin aspect and is specifically not tied to the workings of the Umbra or Astral realms. The Far Shores are a place of mind bending terror and practitioners of this path are forever warped by its deeper understandings. The character gains the "Desensitization" derangement permanently, which can never be bought off. Furthermore, whenever a level of the path is activated, the Derangement is automatically triggered and Willpower may not be spent to suppress the derangement. Use of this Eastern Necromancy path requires intense focus and as a result, its levels may never be activated during combat.
Desensitization: Commonly found among vampires, the character has lost every feeling in his dead body. This affects his ability to feel any emotion except in highly rationalized forms or through foreign influences like the Blood Bond or Dominate. Such desensitization makes it difficult to truly devote oneself to Humanity or a Path of Enlightenment, causing a forced retest on degeneration checks.

Cross-reference: This entry covers the same content as 'Path Beyond' (also in OWBN Custom Paths), submitted with the article prefix. Both entries are preserved for completeness.
rows.Levels: [{"Level": 1, "Name": "Watch the Wending (Basic)", "Description": "The Necromancer is always aware of current conditions in the nearby Tempest or \"Far Shore\" they are visiting and can take shortcuts between two Shadowlands locations. System: By spending a point of Willpower, the character becomes in tune with the realm and gains a sense of nearby dangers, hidden pathways or strange laws that govern the realm. The player should work with their storyteller for degrees of understanding. Some secrets may require a Cosmology test."}, {"Level": 2, "Name": "Donning the Phantom Cloak (Basic)", "Description": "The Necromancer can manifest protective robes that ward off Maelstrom and Tempest's harmful environmental effects. System: By spending a point of Willpower, the Necromancer conjures forth a ghostly cloak. While wearing it, the character suffers no damage or debilitating effects from the Maelstrom or Tempest. At Storyteller discretion, these protections even extend to the environmental dangers that can be found in the Far Shores."}, {"Level": 3, "Name": "Walking Beyond (Intermediate)", "Description": "The Necromancer can manipulate the membrane between the Shadowlands and Tempest, allowing them to enter the Tempest without opening a Nihil. System: The Necromancer spends a point of Willpower and makes a physical challenge at difficulty 8. If successful, the character passes into the Tempest."}, {"Level": 4, "Name": "Sojourn (Intermediate)", "Description": "A Necromancer may manipulate the metaphysical shortcuts through the Tempest. System: Spend a Willpower and make a Static Mental challenge at difficulty 8, if successful the character collapses into a cold, black wind and safely passes into the Tempest and from there may use physical challenges to journey through to other places such as Stygia or even the Far Shores. This can greatly reduce the distance traveled. Storytellers are to keep in mind things like trods and moon bridges when thinking about how this modifies a journey through the shadowlands. This power never takes a character more than 100 miles when traveling to an earthly destination."}, {"Level": 5, "Name": "The Walker in Darkness (Advanced)", "Description": "At this level, the Necromancer has mastered their ability to traverse the Tempest and personally witness the wonders and horrors that lie beyond. System: The character may spend a point of Willpower while in the Tempest to instantaneously travel to any of the Far Shores that they have already visited or any location in the Underworld that they have been to, provided it does not have a reflection in the skinlands. This power is intended for travel to dark and mysterious locations. It is not a travel shortcut to mundane places and should not be treated as such."}]

rows.Description:
The paths of Spirit Manipulation and the Path of the Velvet Shadow form the other two Dur-An-Ki Paths that created a trinity of mastery over the spiritual. Where as Necromancy deals with the Soul and Death; these three paths form the core of mastery over the Spiritual and the Divine. The path of Aether Crafting allows an Ashipu to manipulate the very spiritual essence of the creatures that inhabit the divine world. With mastery over very essence of spirits, an ashipu gains insight into the very essence of themselves and others.
